Toss the vegetables with the oil, chili flakes and garlic, salt and pepper and spread out on a baking tray in one layer, with space between the pieces.
Roast for about 15 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned at the edges.
To finish, squeeze over lemon.

recipes.title: Za'atar Roasted Carrots
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, za'atar, salt and pepper and spread out on a baking tray in one layer, with space between the pieces.
Roast for about 30 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned at the edges.
To finish, serve over a swoosh of yogurt.

recipes.title: Roasted Eggplant with Yogurt and Mint
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, cumin, salt and pepper and spread out on a baking tray in one layer, with space between the pieces.
Roast for about 30 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned at the edges.
To finish, top with garlicky yogurt and mint.

recipes.title: Roasted Radishes with Butter
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, thyme, salt and pepper and spread out on a baking tray in one layer, with space between the pieces.
Roast for about 20 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned at the edges.
To finish, toss with butter and chives.

recipes.title: Roasted Brussels Sprouts with Bacon
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, chopped bacon, salt and pepper and spread out on a baking tray in one layer, with space between the pieces.
Roast for about 25 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned at the edges.
To finish, drizzle with maple syrup.

recipes.title: Roasted Cabbage Wedges
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, caraway and garlic powder, salt and pepper and spread out on a baking tray in one layer, with space between the pieces.
Roast for about 30 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned at the edges.
To finish, splash with vinegar.

recipes.title: Garlic Mashed Cauliflower
steps: Boil the cauliflower and garlic in salted water 12 to 15 minutes until very soft.
Drain well and let steam dry for 2 minutes.
Mash or blend with the butter, parmesan and milk until smooth, then season.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Mash with Brown Butter
steps: Boil the sweet potatoes 15 minutes until soft and drain.
Cook the butter in a small pan until it smells nutty and turns golden brown.
Mash the potatoes with the butter, nutmeg and salt.

recipes.title: Colcannon
steps: Boil the potatoes 15 to 20 minutes until tender and drain.
Meanwhile soften the cabbage in 1 tbsp butter for 5 minutes, adding the green onions at the end.
Warm the milk, then mash it into the potatoes with the rest of the butter.
Fold in the cabbage, season and serve with a knob of butter on top.

recipes.title: Celeriac and Potato Mash
steps: Boil the celeriac and potatoes together for 18 to 20 minutes until soft.
Drain and mash with the butter and warm milk.
Season with salt and white pepper.

recipes.title: Hasselback Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F). Lay each potato between two chopsticks and cut thin slices down to the chopsticks so it stays joined at the base.
Mix the butter, oil and garlic and brush over, getting into the cuts.
Roast 45 to 50 minutes, brushing again halfway, until crisp.
Sprinkle with parmesan and salt for the last 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Smashed Potatoes with Garlic
steps: Boil the potatoes 15 to 20 minutes until tender, then drain.
Put on an oiled tray and press each one flat with a glass.
Drizzle with oil and garlic, season and roast at 220°C (425°F) for 25 minutes until crisp.
Scatter with parsley.

recipes.title: Potatoes Lyonnaise
steps: Boil the potato slices for 5 minutes and drain.
Cook the onions slowly in 1 tbsp butter for 15 minutes until golden.
Fry the potatoes in the oil and remaining butter in batches until crisp.
Toss with the onions, season and finish with parsley.

recipes.title: Sauteed Kale with Garlic and Lemon
steps: Warm the oil with the garlic and chili until fragrant.
Add the kale and a splash of water, cover and cook 4 minutes.
Uncover and toss until tender, then season and squeeze over lemon.

recipes.title: Creamed Spinach
steps: Wilt the spinach in a large pan with a splash of water, then squeeze dry and chop.
Soften the shallot and garlic in the butter.
Stir in the cream cheese, milk, parmesan and nutmeg until smooth.
Fold in the spinach and heat through.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Cabbage with Garlic
steps: Heat the oil in a wok until very hot and fry the garlic for 20 seconds.
Add the cabbage and stir-fry 4 minutes until wilted with some charred edges.
Add the soy sauce, vinegar and sugar and toss.

recipes.title: Peas with Mint and Butter
steps: Cook the peas in boiling salted water for 3 minutes.
Drain and toss with the butter, mint and a little salt.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Corn on the Cob
steps: Boil the corn for 6 to 8 minutes until tender.
Mash the butter with the garlic, parsley and salt.
Spread over the hot corn.

recipes.title: Sesame Green Beans
steps: Blanch the beans for 2 minutes and drain.
Stir-fry in the hot oil with the garlic for 3 minutes until blistered.
Toss with the soy sauce, sesame oil and seeds.

recipes.title: Summer Vegetable Ratatouille
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in half the oil, then remove.
Brown the eggplant, zucchini and peppers in batches in the rest of the oil.
Return everything, add the tomatoes and herbs and simmer gently 30 minutes until soft and rich.
Finish with torn basil. It is even better the next day.

recipes.title: Glazed Turnips

ingredients.name: Turnips, peeled and cut into wedges

steps: Put the turnips, butter, sugar and stock in a wide pan in one layer.
Simmer uncovered for 15 minutes until the turnips are tender and the liquid has reduced.
Keep cooking, shaking the pan, until they are coated in a shiny glaze.

recipes.title: Sauteed Zucchini and Corn
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 3 minutes.
Add the zucchini, corn and cumin and cook 6 minutes until tender.
Season, squeeze over lime and top with the cheese.

recipes.title: Saffron Rice
steps: Soak the saffron in 2 tbsp hot water.
Rinse the rice, then fry it in the butter for 1 minute.
Add the water, saffron and salt, bring to a boil, cover and cook on the lowest heat 15 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes and fluff.

recipes.title: Brown Butter Orzo with Parmesan
steps: Cook the orzo in the butter, stirring, until both are toasty brown.
Add the stock and simmer 9 to 10 minutes, stirring, until absorbed.
Stir in the parmesan and parsley.

recipes.title: Rice Pilaf with Vermicelli
steps: Toast the vermicelli in the butter until golden brown.
Add the rinsed rice and stir 1 minute.
Add the stock and salt, bring to a boil, cover and cook on low 15 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes and fluff.

recipes.title: Mushroom Rice
steps: Fry the mushrooms and onion in the butter for 6 minutes.
Add the rice and thyme and stir 1 minute.
Add the stock, cover and cook on low 15 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes and fluff.

recipes.title: Coconut Turmeric Rice
steps: Rinse the rice well.
Put everything in a pan, bring to a boil, cover and cook on low 15 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes, remove the lemongrass and fluff.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Rice
steps: Fry the garlic in the butter for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the rice and stir to coat.
Add the stock, cover and cook on low 15 minutes.
Fluff and stir in the parsley.

recipes.title: Herbed Bulgur Pilaf
steps: Soften the onion in the oil, stir in the tomato paste.
Add the bulgur and stock, cover and simmer 12 minutes.
Rest off the heat 5 minutes, fluff and stir in the parsley.

recipes.title: Creamy Polenta
steps: Bring the water to a boil with 1 tsp salt.
Whisk in the polenta slowly and cook, stirring often, as the packet says (5 minutes for quick-cook).
Beat in the butter and parmesan.

recipes.title: Mexican Black Beans
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil for 4 minutes.
Add the beans with their liquid, cumin and oregano and simmer 10 minutes until thick.
Season and squeeze over lime.

recipes.title: Braised White Beans with Garlic
steps: Warm the garlic and rosemary in the oil until fragrant.
Add the beans and stock and simmer 10 minutes, crushing a few beans to thicken.
Season and drizzle with more oil.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Roasted Potatoes
steps: Toss the potatoes with the oil, garlic powder, paprika and salt.
Air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 18 to 20 minutes, shaking twice, until crisp outside and tender inside.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Broccoli
steps: Toss the broccoli with the oil, garlic powder and salt.
Air fry at 190°C (375°F) for 7 to 8 minutes, shaking once, until crisp at the tips.
Squeeze over lemon.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Zucchini Chips
steps: Dip the zucchini in beaten egg, then in the panko mixed with parmesan.
Spray and air fry in a single layer at 200°C (400°F) for 10 to 12 minutes, turning once.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Onion Rings
steps: Coat the rings in seasoned flour, then in the egg whisked with buttermilk, then panko mixed with paprika.
Spray and air fry at 200°C (400°F) in batches for 8 to 10 minutes, turning once, until golden.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Green Beans
steps: Toss the beans with the oil, garlic powder and salt.
Air fry at 190°C (375°F) for 7 to 8 minutes, shaking once.
Toss with parmesan.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Corn on the Cob
steps: Brush the corn with half the butter.
Air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 10 to 12 minutes, turning halfway, until charred in spots.
Brush with the rest of the butter, sprinkle with chili and salt and squeeze over lime.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Cauliflower with Turmeric
steps: Toss the cauliflower with the oil and spices.
Air fry at 190°C (375°F) for 12 to 14 minutes, shaking twice, until tender and browned.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Butternut Squash
steps: Toss the squash with the oil, sage and salt.
Air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 15 to 18 minutes, shaking twice.
Drizzle with maple syrup.

recipes.title: Pear and Ginger Crisp
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and butter a 20 x 30 cm baking dish.
Toss the fruit with the sugar, spices and cornstarch and spread in the dish.
Rub the flour, oats, sugar, cinnamon, salt and butter together with your fingertips until clumpy, then mix in the nuts.
Scatter the topping over the fruit and bake 40 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges.
Cool 10 minutes and serve warm with ice cream, yogurt or custard.

recipes.title: Rhubarb and Strawberry Crumble
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and butter a 20 x 30 cm baking dish.
Toss the fruit with the sugar, spices and cornstarch and spread in the dish.
Rub the flour, oats, sugar, cinnamon, salt and butter together with your fingertips until clumpy.
Scatter the topping over the fruit and bake 40 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges.
Cool 10 minutes and serve warm with ice cream, yogurt or custard.

recipes.title: Cherry Almond Crisp
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and butter a 20 x 30 cm baking dish.
Toss the fruit with the sugar, spices and cornstarch and spread in the dish.
Rub the flour, oats, sugar, cinnamon, salt and butter together with your fingertips until clumpy, then mix in the nuts.
Scatter the topping over the fruit and bake 35 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges.
Cool 10 minutes and serve warm with ice cream, yogurt or custard.

recipes.title: Plum Crumble with Cinnamon
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and butter a 20 x 30 cm baking dish.
Toss the fruit with the sugar, spices and cornstarch and spread in the dish.
Rub the flour, oats, sugar, cinnamon, salt and butter together with your fingertips until clumpy.
Scatter the topping over the fruit and bake 35 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges.
Cool 10 minutes and serve warm with ice cream, yogurt or custard.

recipes.title: Mixed Berry Oat Crisp
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and butter a 20 x 30 cm baking dish.
Toss the fruit with the sugar, spices and cornstarch and spread in the dish.
Rub the flour, oats, sugar, cinnamon, salt and butter together with your fingertips until clumpy.
Scatter the topping over the fruit and bake 40 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges.
Cool 10 minutes and serve warm with ice cream, yogurt or custard.

recipes.title: Peach and Blueberry Crisp
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and butter a 20 x 30 cm baking dish.
Toss the fruit with the sugar, spices and cornstarch and spread in the dish.
Rub the flour, oats, sugar, cinnamon, salt and butter together with your fingertips until clumpy.
Scatter the topping over the fruit and bake 40 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges.
Cool 10 minutes and serve warm with ice cream, yogurt or custard.

recipes.title: Vanilla Custard Pudding
steps: Whisk the yolks, sugar, cornstarch and salt in a pan, then whisk in the milk.
Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly, until it thickens and bubbles, then cook 1 minute more.
Off the heat stir in the butter and vanilla.
Pour into cups, press plastic wrap on the surface and chill 2 hours.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Pudding
steps: Melt the butter with the brown sugar and cook 3 minutes until bubbling and darker.
Whisk the milk, cornstarch, yolks and salt and pour in slowly, whisking.
Cook, whisking, until thick, about 5 minutes.
Add the vanilla, pour into cups and chill.

recipes.title: Coconut Chia Pudding with Mango
steps: Whisk the coconut milk, almond milk, chia, maple syrup and vanilla.
Rest 10 minutes, whisk again to break up clumps, then chill at least 3 hours or overnight.
Serve topped with the mango.

recipes.title: Lemon Posset
steps: Bring the cream and sugar to a boil and simmer 3 minutes, stirring.
Off the heat stir in the lemon zest and juice; it will thicken.
Pour into glasses and chill at least 3 hours until set.
Top with raspberries.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pots de Creme
steps: Heat the oven to 150°C (300°F).
Bring the cream and milk to a simmer, pour over the chocolate and stir until smooth.
Whisk the yolks, sugar and salt, then whisk in the chocolate cream.
Pour into 6 small cups in a roasting tin, add hot water halfway up and bake 25 to 30 minutes until just set with a slight wobble. Chill.

recipes.title: Sticky Rice Pudding with Coconut
steps: Simmer the rice in the water for 15 minutes, stirring.
Add the coconut milk, sugar and salt and cook 15 minutes more, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Stir in the vanilla and serve warm or cold.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
steps: Cook the milk, sugar, cornstarch and yolks, whisking, until thick; stir in the vanilla and cool.
Whip the cream to soft peaks and fold half into the custard.
Layer wafers, bananas and custard in a dish twice, then spread the remaining cream on top.
Chill at least 4 hours so the wafers soften.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding with Cardamom and Pistachios
steps: Simmer the rice in the milk over low heat for 35 to 40 minutes, stirring often, until creamy and thick.
Stir in the sugar, cardamom and saffron and cook 5 minutes more.
Serve warm or chilled with pistachios.

recipes.title: No-Churn Vanilla Ice Cream
steps: Whip the cream to stiff peaks.
Fold in the condensed milk, vanilla and salt.
Spread in a loaf tin, cover and freeze at least 6 hours.

recipes.title: No-Churn Strawberry Ice Cream
steps: Blend the strawberries with the lemon juice.
Whip the cream to stiff peaks and fold in the condensed milk.
Fold in the strawberry puree, leaving some ripples.
Freeze in a loaf tin for at least 6 hours.

recipes.title: Mango Sorbet
steps: Blend everything in a food processor until completely smooth, scraping down often.
Serve straight away as soft-serve, or freeze 1 hour for scoopable sorbet.

recipes.title: Lemon Granita
steps: Heat the water and sugar until dissolved, then cool and add the lemon zest and juice.
Pour into a shallow dish and freeze.
Every 30 minutes for 3 hours, scrape with a fork into icy crystals.
Serve in chilled glasses.

recipes.title: Coffee Granita
steps: Stir the sugar into the hot coffee until dissolved and cool.
Freeze in a shallow dish, scraping with a fork every 30 minutes for 3 hours.
Serve topped with lightly whipped cream.

recipes.title: Berry Yogurt Popsicles
steps: Stir the yogurt with the honey and vanilla.
Crush the berries lightly.
Layer yogurt and berries in popsicle molds, add sticks and freeze at least 5 hours.

recipes.title: Frozen Banana Bites
steps: Sandwich pairs of banana slices with a little peanut butter and freeze 30 minutes.
Melt the chocolate with the coconut oil.
Dip the banana sandwiches, sprinkle with peanuts and freeze on a lined tray for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Nice Cream
steps: Blend everything in a food processor, scraping down, until smooth and creamy.
Eat as soft-serve or freeze 1 hour to firm up.

recipes.title: Raspberry Semifreddo
steps: Line a loaf tin with plastic wrap. Mash two thirds of the raspberries.
Whisk the eggs and sugar in a bowl over simmering water until thick, pale and hot to the touch (about 70°C/160°F), then whisk until cool.
Whip the cream with the vanilla and fold into the eggs, then fold in the mashed raspberries and whole berries.
Freeze at least 6 hours and slice to serve.

recipes.title: Grilled Peaches with Honey Yogurt
steps: Brush the cut sides of the peaches with oil.
Grill or griddle cut side down 4 to 6 minutes until charred and softened.
Serve with yogurt, drizzled with honey and pistachios.

recipes.title: Roasted Plums with Vanilla
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Put the plums cut side up in a dish, sprinkle with sugar, add the vanilla, juice and dots of butter.
Roast 15 to 20 minutes until soft and syrupy.
Serve warm with cream or ice cream.

recipes.title: Strawberries with Balsamic and Black Pepper
steps: Toss the strawberries with the sugar, balsamic and pepper.
Leave 15 minutes to release their juices.
Scatter with torn basil and serve with mascarpone or ice cream.

recipes.title: Baked Pears with Walnuts and Maple
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F).
Set the pears cut side up in a dish, fill the hollows with walnuts and drizzle with the maple syrup and butter.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and bake 25 to 30 minutes until tender.

recipes.title: Bananas Foster
steps: Melt the butter with the sugar and cinnamon until bubbling.
Add the bananas and cook 2 minutes a side.
If using rum, take the pan off the heat, add it and carefully return to the heat to bubble off the alcohol (keep a lid handy).
Spoon over ice cream.

recipes.title: Raspberry Fool
steps: Cook half the berries with the sugar for 5 minutes, then cool.
Whip the cream to soft peaks and fold in the yogurt.
Ripple through the cooked and fresh berries and spoon into glasses.

recipes.title: Eton Mess
steps: Toss the strawberries with the sugar and leave 10 minutes.
Whip the cream to soft peaks.
Fold together the cream, meringue and most of the strawberries and pile into glasses with the rest on top.

recipes.title: Caramelized Pineapple with Lime
steps: Toss the pineapple with the sugar.
Cook in the butter in a hot pan 3 to 4 minutes a side until caramelized.
Squeeze over lime and scatter with mint.

recipes.title: Chocolate Truffles
steps: Bring the cream to a simmer and pour over the chocolate and butter; stir until smooth.
Chill 2 hours until firm.
Scoop into small balls, roll quickly between your palms and toss in cocoa.
Keep in the fridge.

recipes.title: No-Bake Chocolate Oat Cookies
steps: Bring the butter, sugar, milk and cocoa to a rolling boil and boil exactly 1 minute.
Off the heat stir in the peanut butter, vanilla and oats.
Drop spoonfuls onto parchment and leave 30 minutes to set.

recipes.title: Rocky Road
steps: Melt the chocolate, butter and syrup together gently.
Stir in the biscuits, marshmallows and cherries.
Press into a lined 20 cm square tin and chill 2 hours.
Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Icebox Cake
steps: Whip the cream with the sugar and vanilla to soft peaks.
In a loaf tin lined with plastic wrap, layer cookies and cream, finishing with cream.
Chill overnight so the cookies soften into cake.
Turn out and top with grated chocolate.

recipes.title: No-Bake Peanut Butter Bars
steps: Mix the crumbs, butter, peanut butter and sugar and press into a lined 20 cm square tin.
Melt the chocolate chips and spread over.
Chill 1 hour and cut into bars.

recipes.title: Microwave Peanut Butter Mug Cake
steps: Stir everything together in a large mug until smooth.
Microwave 60 to 90 seconds until risen and just set; ovens vary, so check after 60 seconds.
Cool 1 minute before eating.

recipes.title: Lemon Mug Cake
steps: Whisk everything in a large mug.
Microwave 60 to 80 seconds until risen.
Drizzle with a little extra lemon juice mixed with sugar.

recipes.title: Chocolate Dipped Strawberries
steps: Pat the strawberries completely dry.
Melt the dark chocolate in short bursts in the microwave, stirring.
Dip each berry and set on parchment; drizzle with melted white chocolate if you like.
Chill 20 minutes to set.

recipes.title: Affogato
steps: Put 2 scoops of ice cream in each glass.
Pour a shot of hot espresso over each.
Top with grated chocolate and serve straight away.

recipes.title: Cheesecake Bars
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (325°F) and line a 20 cm square tin.
Mix the crumbs and butter and press into the tin; bake 8 minutes.
Beat the cream cheese and sugar until smooth, then the eggs, sour cream, vanilla and zest.
Pour over the base and bake 30 to 35 minutes until set with a slight wobble. Cool, then chill 4 hours before cutting.

recipes.title: Flourless Chocolate Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a 20 cm round tin.
Melt the chocolate and butter together, then whisk in the sugar.
Whisk in the eggs one at a time, then the cocoa and salt.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes until the top is set but the middle is still a little soft. Cool in the tin; it sinks and becomes fudgy.

recipes.title: Rustic Apple Galette
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Roll the pastry to a 30 cm circle on a lined tray.
Toss the apples with the sugar, cinnamon and flour and pile in the middle, leaving a 5 cm border.
Fold the border over the fruit, dot with butter and brush the pastry with egg.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes until golden. Brush the apples with warm jam.

recipes.title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F). Pour the melted butter into a 23 cm round tin, sprinkle with the brown sugar and arrange the pineapple (and cherries) on top.
Cream the soft butter and sugar, beat in the eggs and vanilla, then fold in the flour and baking powder with the milk.
Spread over the fruit and bake 40 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool 10 minutes, then turn out onto a plate.

recipes.title: Cherry Clafoutis
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and butter a 23 cm dish.
Spread the cherries in the dish.
Whisk the eggs and sugar, then the flour, then the milk and vanilla to a smooth batter.
Pour over the cherries and bake 35 minutes until puffed and set. Dust with powdered sugar and serve warm.

recipes.title: Molten Chocolate Lava Cakes
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F). Butter 4 ramekins and dust with cocoa.
Melt the chocolate and butter together.
Whisk the 2 eggs, 2 yolks and sugar until thick, fold in the chocolate, then the flour.
Divide between the ramekins and bake 10 to 12 minutes until the edges are firm but the centres wobble. Rest 1 minute and turn out.

recipes.title: Sticky Toffee Pudding
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and butter a 20 x 30 cm dish.
Soak the dates in the boiling water with the baking soda for 10 minutes.
Cream 50 g butter with 100 g sugar, beat in the eggs, fold in the flour, then the dates and their liquid. Bake 30 to 35 minutes.
For the sauce, simmer the rest of the butter and sugar with the cream and syrup for 3 minutes. Pour over the warm pudding.

recipes.title: Puff Pastry Apple Turnovers
steps: Cook the apples with the butter, sugar and cinnamon for 5 minutes until just soft, then cool.
Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Cut the pastry into 8 squares.
Put a spoonful of apple on each, fold into triangles and press the edges with a fork.
Brush with egg, cut a small slit in each and bake 18 to 20 minutes until puffed and golden.

recipes.title: Pavlova with Berries
steps: Heat the oven to 120°C (250°F) and line a tray.
Whisk the whites to soft peaks, then add the sugar a spoonful at a time, whisking to a thick glossy meringue. Fold in the cornstarch and vinegar.
Spread into a 20 cm round with a dip in the middle and bake 75 minutes, then cool in the switched-off oven.
Top with whipped cream and berries just before serving.

recipes.title: Chocolate Bread Pudding
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and butter a baking dish.
Whisk the milk, cream, eggs, sugar, cocoa and vanilla.
Toss the bread and chocolate chips in the dish, pour over the custard and press down; soak 15 minutes.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes until set and crisp on top.

recipes.title: Peach Galette with Almond
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F) and roll the pastry onto a lined tray.
Sprinkle the almond flour in the middle, leaving a 5 cm border.
Toss the peaches with sugar and cornstarch and pile on top, then fold up the edges.
Brush with egg, scatter with almonds and bake 35 to 40 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Vegan Chocolate Mousse with Aquafaba

ingredients.name: Chickpeas, liquid only (keep the chickpeas for another recipe)
Dark chocolate, dairy-free, melted and cooled

steps: Whip the chickpea liquid with the cream of tartar to soft peaks, about 5 minutes.
Add the sugar gradually and whip to stiff glossy peaks.
Fold in the cooled chocolate gently in three parts.
Spoon into glasses and chill at least 4 hours.

recipes.title: Baked Custard Tarts
steps: Heat the oven to 240°C (475°F). Roll the pastry into a log, cut into 12 rounds and press each into a muffin tin cup.
Cook the yolks, sugar, cornstarch and milk over medium heat, whisking, until thick, then add the vanilla.
Fill the pastry cups three quarters full.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes until the pastry is crisp and the tops have dark spots. Dust with cinnamon.

recipes.title: Lemon Poppy Seed Loaf
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a 900 g (2 lb) loaf tin.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt and spices in a bowl.
In another bowl whisk the sugar, eggs, milk, oil and lemons, then stir into the dry ingredients until just combined.
Scrape into the tin.
Bake 50 to 60 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes in the tin, then on a rack.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Banana Loaf
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a 900 g (2 lb) loaf tin.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt and spices in a bowl.
In another bowl whisk the sugar, eggs, milk, oil and bananas, then stir into the dry ingredients until just combined.
Fold in the chocolate chips and scrape into the tin.
Bake 55 to 65 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes in the tin, then on a rack.

recipes.title: Cranberry Orange Bread
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a 900 g (2 lb) loaf tin.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt and spices in a bowl.
In another bowl whisk the sugar, eggs, milk, oil and orange, then stir into the dry ingredients until just combined.
Fold in the cranberries and scrape into the tin.
Bake 55 to 65 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes in the tin, then on a rack.

recipes.title: Apple Cinnamon Loaf
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a 900 g (2 lb) loaf tin.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt and spices in a bowl.
In another bowl whisk the sugar, eggs, milk, oil and grated apple, then stir into the dry ingredients until just combined.
Fold in the diced apple and scrape into the tin.
Bake 55 to 65 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes in the tin, then on a rack.

recipes.title: Date and Walnut Loaf

ingredients.name: Dates, chopped and soaked in 150 ml hot water

steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a 900 g (2 lb) loaf tin.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt and spices in a bowl.
In another bowl whisk the sugar, eggs, milk, oil and dates, then stir into the dry ingredients until just combined.
Fold in the walnuts and scrape into the tin.
Bake 55 to 65 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes in the tin, then on a rack.

recipes.title: Marbled Chocolate Loaf Cake

ingredients.name: Cocoa powder, mixed with 2 tbsp milk

steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a 900 g (2 lb) loaf tin.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt in a bowl.
In another bowl whisk the sugar, eggs, milk, oil and vanilla extract, then stir into the dry ingredients until just combined.
Pour half the batter into the tin, stir the cocoa paste into the rest, spoon it on top and swirl with a knife.
Bake 50 to 60 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes in the tin, then on a rack.

recipes.title: Strawberry Yogurt Loaf
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a 900 g (2 lb) loaf tin.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt in a bowl.
In another bowl whisk the sugar, eggs, milk, oil and greek yogurt; 1 tsp, then stir into the dry ingredients until just combined.
Fold in the strawberries and scrape into the tin.
Bake 55 to 65 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes in the tin, then on a rack.

recipes.title: Pistachio Cardamom Loaf
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a 900 g (2 lb) loaf tin.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt and spices in a bowl.
In another bowl whisk the sugar, eggs, milk, oil and rose water, then stir into the dry ingredients until just combined.
Fold in the pistachios and scrape into the tin.
Bake 50 to 60 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes in the tin, then on a rack.

recipes.title: Classic Cream Scones
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F) and line a tray.
Mix the flour, baking powder, salt and sugar, then rub in the butter until it looks like breadcrumbs.
Stir in the milk beaten with the egg (keep 1 tbsp for brushing) to make a soft dough; do not overwork it.
Pat out 3 cm thick, cut into 8 wedges or rounds, brush with the reserved egg and bake 12 to 15 minutes until risen and golden.
Serve warm with jam and clotted or whipped cream.

recipes.title: Blueberry Lemon Scones
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F) and line a tray.
Mix the flour, baking powder, salt and sugar, then rub in the butter until it looks like breadcrumbs.
Stir in the flavourings and the blueberries, then the milk beaten with the egg (keep 1 tbsp for brushing) to make a soft dough; do not overwork it.
Pat out 3 cm thick, cut into 8 wedges or rounds, brush with the reserved egg and bake 12 to 15 minutes until risen and golden.
Serve warm with butter or lemon curd.

recipes.title: Cheddar Chive Scones
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F) and line a tray.
Mix the flour, baking powder, salt, then rub in the butter until it looks like breadcrumbs.
Stir in the cheddar and chives, then the milk beaten with the egg (keep 1 tbsp for brushing) to make a soft dough; do not overwork it.
Pat out 3 cm thick, cut into 8 wedges or rounds, brush with the reserved egg and bake 12 to 15 minutes until risen and golden.
Serve warm with butter.

recipes.title: Cranberry Orange Scones
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F) and line a tray.
Mix the flour, baking powder, salt and sugar, then rub in the butter until it looks like breadcrumbs.
Stir in the flavourings and the dried cranberries, then the milk beaten with the egg (keep 1 tbsp for brushing) to make a soft dough; do not overwork it.
Pat out 3 cm thick, cut into 8 wedges or rounds, brush with the reserved egg and bake 12 to 15 minutes until risen and golden.
Serve warm with butter.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Scones
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F) and line a tray.
Mix the flour, baking powder, salt and sugar, then rub in the butter until it looks like breadcrumbs.
Stir in the flavourings and the chocolate chips, then the milk beaten with the egg (keep 1 tbsp for brushing) to make a soft dough; do not overwork it.
Pat out 3 cm thick, cut into 8 wedges or rounds, brush with the reserved egg and bake 12 to 15 minutes until risen and golden.
Serve warm with a glass of milk.

recipes.title: Date and Oat Scones
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F) and line a tray.
Mix the flour, baking powder, salt and sugar, then rub in the butter until it looks like breadcrumbs.
Stir in the dates and rolled oats, then the milk beaten with the egg (keep 1 tbsp for brushing) to make a soft dough; do not overwork it.
Pat out 3 cm thick, cut into 8 wedges or rounds, brush with the reserved egg and bake 12 to 15 minutes until risen and golden.
Serve warm with butter and honey.

recipes.title: Oat Flapjacks
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a 20 cm square tin.
Melt the butter, sugar and syrup together, then stir in the oats and salt.
Press firmly into the tin and bake 20 to 25 minutes until golden at the edges.
Cut into squares while warm, then cool completely in the tin.

recipes.title: Blondies
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a 20 cm square tin.
Whisk the butter and sugar, then the egg and vanilla.
Fold in the flour, baking powder, salt and chocolate.
Spread in the tin and bake 22 to 25 minutes until golden but still soft in the middle. Cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Raspberry Oat Bars
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a 20 x 30 cm tin.
Mix the flour, oats, sugar, butter, baking soda and salt into a crumbly dough.
Press two thirds into the tin, spread with jam and scatter the rest over.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes until golden. Cool before slicing.

recipes.title: Millionaire's Shortbread
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F). Rub the flour, sugar and 120 g butter into a dough, press into a lined 20 cm tin and bake 20 to 25 minutes until pale golden.
Melt the rest of the butter with the condensed milk and syrup and cook, stirring constantly, for 8 to 10 minutes until thick and caramel coloured. Pour over the base and chill 1 hour.
Melt the chocolate, spread over and chill until set.
Cut with a hot knife.

recipes.title: Lemon Coconut Slice
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a 20 cm square tin.
Mix the flour, coconut, sugar and butter and press into the tin; bake 12 minutes.
Whisk the condensed milk with the lemon zest and juice and pour over.
Bake 12 minutes more until just set. Chill and cut.

recipes.title: Chewy Granola Bars
steps: Heat the oven to 170°C (340°F) and line a 20 cm square tin.
Warm the honey, peanut butter and butter until smooth.
Mix with the dry ingredients, press very firmly into the tin and bake 20 to 25 minutes.
Cool completely before cutting into bars.

recipes.title: Double Chocolate Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line two trays.
Cream the butter and sugars, beat in the egg and vanilla.
Mix in the flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt, then the chips.
Roll into balls, space well apart and bake 10 to 11 minutes; they firm up as they cool.

recipes.title: Ginger Molasses Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Cream the butter and brown sugar, then beat in the egg and molasses.
Mix in the flour, baking soda and spices.
Roll into balls, roll in sugar and bake 9 to 10 minutes until crackled.

recipes.title: Lemon Crinkle Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Cream the butter and sugar, beat in the egg, zest and juice.
Mix in the flour, baking powder and salt; chill 20 minutes.
Roll into balls, coat thickly in powdered sugar and bake 10 to 11 minutes.

recipes.title: Almond Butter Cookies (Flourless)
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Mix everything into a soft dough.
Roll into balls, press with a fork and bake 9 to 10 minutes. Cool on the tray; they are fragile while warm.

recipes.title: White Chocolate Cranberry Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Cream the butter and sugar, beat in the egg and vanilla.
Mix in the flour, baking soda and salt, then the chocolate and cranberries.
Bake spoonfuls 10 to 11 minutes until golden at the edges.

recipes.title: Thumbprint Jam Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 175°C (350°F).
Cream the butter and sugar, beat in the yolk and vanilla, then the flour and salt.
Roll into small balls, press a dent in each with your thumb and fill with jam.
Bake 12 to 14 minutes until pale golden.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Cream the butter and sugar, beat in the egg and vanilla.
Mix in the flour, baking soda, cinnamon, oats and chips.
Bake spoonfuls 11 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Irish Soda Bread
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F) and flour a tray.
Mix the flour, baking soda and salt, then stir in the buttermilk to a soft, sticky dough.
Shape into a round, cut a deep cross on top and bake 35 to 40 minutes until it sounds hollow when tapped underneath.
Cool on a rack wrapped in a tea towel for a soft crust.

recipes.title: Garlic Herb Pull-Apart Rolls
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt, add the milk and 30 g butter and knead 8 minutes until smooth. Cover and rise 1 hour.
Shape into 12 balls and pack into a buttered dish; rise 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F). Mix the remaining butter with the garlic and parsley and brush over.
Bake 22 to 25 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Pita Bread
steps: Mix everything into a soft dough and knead 8 minutes. Cover and rise 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 250°C (480°F) with a baking tray inside.
Divide into 8, roll into 15 cm rounds and rest 10 minutes.
Bake 2 or 3 at a time on the hot tray for 4 to 5 minutes until puffed. Wrap in a towel to keep soft.

recipes.title: Rosemary Olive Oil Bread
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, salt, rosemary, water and 2 tbsp oil and knead 10 minutes. Rise 1 hour until doubled.
Shape into a round loaf on a floured tray and rise 45 minutes.
Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F). Brush with the rest of the oil and slash the top.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes until deep golden.

recipes.title: Cheese and Onion Pinwheels
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Spread the pastry with mustard, scatter with cheese and onion and roll up tightly from the long side.
Slice into 12 rounds, lay on a lined tray and brush with egg.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes until puffed and golden.

recipes.title: Zucchini Cheddar Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F) and line a 12-hole muffin tin.
Mix the flour, baking powder and salt, then stir in the zucchini, most of the cheese and the green onions.
Whisk the eggs, milk and oil and fold in until just combined.
Spoon into the tin, top with the rest of the cheese and bake 20 to 22 minutes.

recipes.title: Victoria Sponge
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line two 20 cm round tins.
Beat the butter, sugar, eggs, flour, baking powder and milk until smooth and pale.
Divide between the tins and bake 22 to 25 minutes until springy.
Cool, then sandwich with jam and whipped cream and dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Olive Oil Orange Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a 23 cm round tin.
Whisk the eggs and sugar until pale, then whisk in the oil, zest and juice.
Fold in the flour, baking powder and salt.
Bake 40 to 45 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Apple Cake with Cinnamon Sugar

ingredients.name: Sugar, 150 g for the batter and 25 g for the topping

steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a 23 cm springform tin.
Cream the butter and sugar, beat in the eggs, then fold in the flour, baking powder and milk.
Spread in the tin, press the apple slices into the batter in rings and sprinkle with the cinnamon sugar.
Bake 45 to 50 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.

recipes.title: Gluten-Free Almond Orange Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a 23 cm tin.
Whisk the eggs and sugar until thick and pale.
Fold in the almond flour, zest and baking powder.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes until golden and set. Cool and dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Strawberry Lemonade
steps: Blend the strawberries with 500 ml cold water and the sugar until smooth.
Strain through a sieve into a jug, pressing on the pulp (skip this if you like it pulpy).
Stir in the lime or lemon juice and 500 ml more cold water. Taste and adjust the sweetness.
Chill and serve over plenty of ice.

recipes.title: Mint Limeade
steps: Blend the mint with 500 ml cold water and the sugar until smooth.
Strain through a sieve into a jug, pressing on the pulp (skip this if you like it pulpy).
Stir in the lime or lemon juice and 500 ml more cold water. Taste and adjust the sweetness.
Chill and serve over plenty of ice.

recipes.title: Cucumber Lime Agua Fresca
steps: Blend the cucumbers with 500 ml cold water and the sugar until smooth.
Strain through a sieve into a jug, pressing on the pulp (skip this if you like it pulpy).
Stir in the lime or lemon juice and 500 ml more cold water. Taste and adjust the sweetness.
Chill and serve over plenty of ice.

recipes.title: Pineapple Agua Fresca
steps: Blend the pineapple with 500 ml cold water and the sugar until smooth.
Strain through a sieve into a jug, pressing on the pulp (skip this if you like it pulpy).
Stir in the lime or lemon juice and 500 ml more cold water. Taste and adjust the sweetness.
Chill and serve over plenty of ice.

recipes.title: Cantaloupe Agua Fresca
steps: Blend the cantaloupe with 500 ml cold water and the sugar until smooth.
Strain through a sieve into a jug, pressing on the pulp (skip this if you like it pulpy).
Stir in the lime or lemon juice and 500 ml more cold water. Taste and adjust the sweetness.
Chill and serve over plenty of ice.

recipes.title: Honey Mint Lemonade
steps: Stir the honey into 250 ml warm water until dissolved.
Add the mint, lemon juice and 750 ml cold water and stir, then leave 10 minutes for the mint to infuse.
Chill and serve over plenty of ice.

recipes.title: Ginger Lemonade
steps: Bring 500 ml water to a boil with the sugar, add the ginger and steep off the heat for 15 minutes.
Strain into a jug and add 750 ml cold water and the citrus juice.
Chill and serve over plenty of ice.

recipes.title: Hibiscus Agua Fresca (Jamaica)
steps: Bring 500 ml water to a boil with the sugar, add the dried hibiscus flowers and cinnamon and steep off the heat for 15 minutes.
Strain into a jug and add 750 ml cold water and the citrus juice.
Chill and serve over plenty of ice.

recipes.title: Tropical Mango Pineapple Smoothie
steps: Put everything in a blender, liquids first.
Blend on high for 45 to 60 seconds until completely smooth, adding a splash more liquid if it is too thick.
Pour into glasses and drink straight away.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie
steps: Put everything in a blender, liquids first.
Blend on high for 45 to 60 seconds until completely smooth, adding a splash more liquid if it is too thick.
Pour into glasses and drink straight away.

recipes.title: Berry Spinach Smoothie
steps: Put everything in a blender, liquids first.
Blend on high for 45 to 60 seconds until completely smooth, adding a splash more liquid if it is too thick.
Pour into glasses and drink straight away.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cherry Smoothie
steps: Put everything in a blender, liquids first.
Blend on high for 45 to 60 seconds until completely smooth, adding a splash more liquid if it is too thick.
Pour into glasses and drink straight away.

recipes.title: Kiwi Apple Green Smoothie
steps: Put everything in a blender, liquids first.
Blend on high for 45 to 60 seconds until completely smooth, adding a splash more liquid if it is too thick.
Pour into glasses and drink straight away.

recipes.title: Coffee Banana Breakfast Smoothie
steps: Put everything in a blender, liquids first.
Blend on high for 45 to 60 seconds until completely smooth, adding a splash more liquid if it is too thick.
Pour into glasses and drink straight away.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie Smoothie
steps: Put everything in a blender, liquids first.
Blend on high for 45 to 60 seconds until completely smooth, adding a splash more liquid if it is too thick.
Pour into glasses and drink straight away.

recipes.title: Strawberry Oat Protein Smoothie
steps: Put everything in a blender, liquids first.
Blend on high for 45 to 60 seconds until completely smooth, adding a splash more liquid if it is too thick.
Pour into glasses and drink straight away.

recipes.title: Carrot Orange Ginger Smoothie
steps: Put everything in a blender, liquids first.
Blend on high for 45 to 60 seconds until completely smooth, adding a splash more liquid if it is too thick.
Pour into glasses and drink straight away.

recipes.title: Spiced Apple Cider
steps: Put everything in a pan and bring just to a simmer.
Keep it barely simmering for 15 to 20 minutes.
Strain into mugs and serve hot.

recipes.title: Mexican Hot Chocolate
steps: Heat the milk until steaming.
Whisk in the chocolate, sugar, cinnamon and chili until melted.
Add the vanilla and whisk hard until frothy.

recipes.title: Fresh Ginger Lemon Tea
steps: Simmer the ginger in the water for 10 minutes.
Strain into mugs and add lemon juice and honey to taste.

recipes.title: Turkish-Style Apple Tea
steps: Simmer the apples, cinnamon and cloves in the water for 15 minutes.
Mash lightly, strain and stir in the honey and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.title: London Fog Tea Latte
steps: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes and remove.
Heat and froth the milk with the honey and vanilla.
Pour over the tea.

recipes.title: Mocha Coffee
steps: Whisk the cocoa and sugar into the hot coffee until dissolved.
Heat and froth the milk and pour it in.
Top with whipped cream if you like.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Spice Latte
steps: Whisk the milk, pumpkin, maple syrup and spice in a pan over medium heat until steaming.
Take off the heat, add the vanilla and whisk until frothy.
Pour over the hot coffee.

recipes.title: Matcha Latte
steps: Whisk the matcha with the hot water until smooth and frothy.
Heat and froth the milk with the honey.
Pour the milk over the matcha (or chill both and serve over ice).

recipes.title: Salted Lassi
steps: Blend the yogurt, water and salt until frothy.
Pour over ice and sprinkle with the cumin and torn mint.

recipes.title: Rose Lassi
steps: Blend the yogurt, milk, sugar and rose water until smooth.
Serve chilled, topped with pistachios.

recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Milkshake
steps: Blend everything until thick and smooth.
Pour into chilled glasses.

recipes.title: Strawberry Milkshake
steps: Blend until smooth.
Serve in chilled glasses with an extra strawberry on top.

recipes.title: Vietnamese-Style Iced Coffee
steps: Stir the condensed milk into the hot coffee.
Pour over glasses full of ice and stir well.

recipes.title: Sweet Tea
steps: Bring 500 ml of the water to a boil, add the tea bags and steep 5 minutes.
Remove the bags and stir in the sugar until dissolved.
Add the remaining cold water and chill. Serve over ice with lemon.

recipes.title: Iced Green Tea with Mint and Lime
steps: Steep the tea bags in 400 ml hot (not boiling) water for 3 minutes and remove.
Stir in the honey, then add the remaining cold water, lime and mint.
Chill and serve over ice.

recipes.title: Virgin Mojito
steps: Muddle the mint, lime wedges and sugar in two glasses.
Fill with ice and top with sparkling water. Stir and serve.

recipes.title: Cranberry Ginger Spritzer
steps: Fill glasses with ice.
Half-fill with cranberry juice and top with ginger ale.
Squeeze in lime and stir gently.

recipes.title: Pineapple Coconut Cooler
steps: Shake or whisk the pineapple juice, coconut water, coconut milk and lime juice.
Pour over ice.

recipes.title: Sparkling Watermelon Mint Cooler
steps: Blend the watermelon with the mint and lime juice and strain.
Pour over ice and top with sparkling water.

recipes.title: Shirley Temple Mocktail
steps: Fill glasses with ice and add the ginger ale.
Pour in the grenadine so it sinks, and add a cherry.

recipes.title: Lemon Tahini Dressing
steps: Put everything in a jar or bowl.
Shake or whisk until smooth and emulsified, adding a splash of water if it is too thick.
Taste and adjust the salt, acid and sweetness. Keeps in the fridge for up to 5 days; good on grain bowls, roasted vegetables and falafel.

recipes.title: Honey Mustard Vinaigrette
steps: Put everything in a jar or bowl.
Shake or whisk until smooth and emulsified, adding a splash of water if it is too thick.
Taste and adjust the salt, acid and sweetness. Keeps in the fridge for up to 5 days; good on green salads and chicken.

recipes.title: Balsamic Vinaigrette
steps: Put everything in a jar or bowl.
Shake or whisk until smooth and emulsified, adding a splash of water if it is too thick.
Taste and adjust the salt, acid and sweetness. Keeps in the fridge for up to 5 days; good on tomato salads and leafy greens.

recipes.title: Sesame Ginger Dressing
steps: Put everything in a jar or bowl.
Shake or whisk until smooth and emulsified, adding a splash of water if it is too thick.
Taste and adjust the salt, acid and sweetness. Keeps in the fridge for up to 5 days; good on slaws, noodle salads and cold soba.

recipes.title: Creamy Caesar Dressing
steps: Put everything in a jar or bowl.
Shake or whisk until smooth and emulsified, adding a splash of water if it is too thick.
Taste and adjust the salt, acid and sweetness. Keeps in the fridge for up to 5 days; good on romaine and croutons.

recipes.title: Greek Lemon Oregano Dressing
steps: Put everything in a jar or bowl.
Shake or whisk until smooth and emulsified, adding a splash of water if it is too thick.
Taste and adjust the salt, acid and sweetness. Keeps in the fridge for up to 5 days; good on Greek salads and grilled chicken.

recipes.title: Cilantro Lime Dressing
steps: Put everything in a jar or bowl (or a blender).
Blend until smooth and pale green.
Taste and adjust the salt, acid and sweetness. Keeps in the fridge for up to 5 days; good on taco salads and burrito bowls.

recipes.title: Miso Ginger Dressing
steps: Put everything in a jar or bowl.
Shake or whisk until smooth and emulsified, adding a splash of water if it is too thick.
Taste and adjust the salt, acid and sweetness. Keeps in the fridge for up to 5 days; good on salads, roasted squash and salmon.

recipes.title: Blue Cheese Dressing
steps: Put everything in a jar or bowl.
Shake or whisk until smooth and emulsified, adding a splash of water if it is too thick.
Taste and adjust the salt, acid and sweetness. Keeps in the fridge for up to 5 days; good on wedge salads and wings.

recipes.title: Green Goddess Dressing
steps: Put everything in a jar or bowl (or a blender).
Blend until smooth and pale green.
Taste and adjust the salt, acid and sweetness. Keeps in the fridge for up to 5 days; good on salads and as a dip.

recipes.title: Peanut Lime Dressing
steps: Put everything in a jar or bowl.
Shake or whisk until smooth and emulsified, adding a splash of water if it is too thick.
Taste and adjust the salt, acid and sweetness. Keeps in the fridge for up to 5 days; good on noodle salads and slaws.

recipes.title: Maple Dijon Dressing
steps: Put everything in a jar or bowl.
Shake or whisk until smooth and emulsified, adding a splash of water if it is too thick.
Taste and adjust the salt, acid and sweetness. Keeps in the fridge for up to 5 days; good on kale and apple salads.

recipes.title: Mango Salsa
steps: Combine everything in a bowl and season with salt.
Rest 10 minutes so the flavours mix. Great with fish tacos, grilled chicken or chips.

recipes.title: Salsa Verde (Tomatillo)
steps: Broil or char the tomatillos, onion, garlic and jalapeno until blackened in spots, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Blend with the cilantro, lime and salt until chunky-smooth.
Cool before serving.

recipes.title: Charred Corn Salsa
steps: Char the corn in the oil in a hot pan for 6 to 8 minutes, then cool.
Mix with everything else and season.

recipes.title: Pineapple Salsa
steps: Mix everything and season.
Serve with pork, fish, tacos or chips.

recipes.title: Tomato Chutney
steps: Put everything in a heavy pan and bring to a boil, stirring until the sugar dissolves.
Simmer uncovered 35 to 40 minutes, stirring more often near the end, until thick and jammy.
Spoon into clean jars and keep in the fridge for up to 3 weeks.

recipes.title: Quick Pickled Red Onions
steps: Pack the onions into a jar.
Heat the vinegar, water, sugar and salt until dissolved and pour over.
Cool, then chill at least 30 minutes; keeps 2 weeks.

recipes.title: Cranberry Sauce
steps: Bring everything to a boil, then simmer 10 minutes until most berries burst.
Cool; it thickens as it sets.

recipes.title: Cucumber Raita
steps: Stir everything together and chill.
Serve with curries, biryani and kebabs.

recipes.title: Apple Chutney
steps: Combine everything in a heavy pan and bring to a boil.
Simmer 35 to 40 minutes, stirring often, until thick.
Cool and store in the fridge for up to 3 weeks; good with cheese and cold meats.

recipes.title: Sun-Dried Tomato Pesto
steps: Blitz everything except the oil in a food processor.
With the motor running, pour in the oil to make a thick paste.
Season; keeps a week in the fridge under a layer of oil.

recipes.title: Arugula Walnut Pesto
steps: Blitz the arugula, walnuts, parmesan, garlic and lemon juice.
Stream in the oil and season.

recipes.title: Vegan Cashew Pesto
steps: Blitz everything except the oil until finely chopped.
Stream in the oil and season.

recipes.title: Romesco Sauce
steps: Blend everything except the oil until coarse.
Add the oil and blend to a thick, slightly textured sauce.
Season; excellent with grilled vegetables, fish and potatoes.

recipes.title: Alfredo Sauce
steps: Melt the butter and cook the garlic gently for 1 minute.
Add the cream and simmer 4 minutes.
Off the heat stir in the parmesan until smooth, and season with nutmeg and pepper.

recipes.title: Creamy Tomato Pasta Sauce
steps: Soften the shallot and garlic in the oil.
Cook the tomato paste and chili for 2 minutes until darkened.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes, then stir in the cream and parmesan.

recipes.title: Enchilada Sauce from Scratch
steps: Cook the flour in the oil for 1 minute, then stir in the spices and tomato paste.
Whisk in the stock gradually.
Simmer 8 to 10 minutes until it coats a spoon.

recipes.title: Hollandaise Sauce
steps: Whisk the yolks and lemon juice in a bowl over barely simmering water until thick and pale.
Take off the heat and whisk in the hot butter in a thin stream.
Season with salt and cayenne and use straight away (eggs benedict, asparagus, fish).

recipes.title: Garlic Aioli
steps: Stir everything together.
Rest 15 minutes for the garlic to mellow. Serve with fries, sandwiches and seafood.

recipes.title: Sweet Chili Sauce
steps: Simmer the vinegar, sugar, water, garlic, chilies and salt for 5 minutes.
Stir in the cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water and simmer until thickened.
Cool; keeps 2 weeks in the fridge.

recipes.title: Chipotle Lime Crema
steps: Stir everything together and chill.
Drizzle over tacos, bowls and grilled corn.

recipes.title: Spicy Peanut Chili Crisp
steps: Fry the shallots in the oil over medium heat until golden, then the garlic until just golden (watch closely).
Pour the hot oil and aromatics over the chili flakes, peanuts, sugar and salt in a heatproof bowl.
Stir in the soy sauce and cool. Keeps a month in the fridge.

recipes.title: Mushroom Gravy
steps: Cook the mushrooms and shallot in the butter for 8 minutes until browned.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in the stock, soy sauce and thyme and simmer until thick.

recipes.title: Ginger Scallion Sauce
steps: Put the green onions, ginger and salt in a heatproof bowl.
Heat the oil until shimmering and pour over to sizzle.
Stir in the soy sauce. Spoon over rice, noodles, chicken or tofu.

recipes.title: Quick Tartar Sauce
steps: Stir everything together.
Serve with fish, fish fingers and crab cakes.

recipes.title: Buffalo Wing Sauce
steps: Melt the butter with the hot sauce, honey and garlic powder, whisking until smooth.
Toss with wings, cauliflower or chicken tenders.

recipes.title: Strawberry Chia Jam
steps: Cook the strawberries for 8 to 10 minutes until broken down, mashing them.
Stir in the maple syrup, lemon and chia and cool.
It sets in the fridge in 1 hour and keeps a week.

recipes.title: Roasted Red Pepper Hummus
steps: Blend everything until very smooth, adding a little water if needed.
Season and serve with a drizzle of oil and pita or vegetables.

recipes.title: Beet Hummus
steps: Blend everything until smooth and bright pink.
Season and serve with crackers or vegetables.

recipes.title: White Bean and Rosemary Dip
steps: Blend everything until creamy.
Serve with a drizzle of oil and toasted bread.

recipes.title: Whipped Feta Dip
steps: Blend the feta and yogurt until very smooth.
Spread in a bowl, drizzle with honey and oil and scatter with lemon zest and chili.

recipes.title: Muhammara
steps: Blend everything to a thick, slightly coarse paste.
Season and serve with pita and vegetables.

recipes.title: Queso Dip
steps: Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk and simmer until thickened.
Add the cheese a handful at a time, stirring until smooth.
Stir in the jalapeno, salsa and cumin and serve warm with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Dip
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F).
Mix the cream cheese, hot sauce and ranch until smooth, then the chicken and half the cheese.
Spread in a small dish, top with the rest of the cheese and bake 20 minutes until bubbling.
Serve with celery and chips.

recipes.title: Spinach Yogurt Dip
steps: Wilt the spinach in the oil, then cool, squeeze dry and chop.
Stir into the yogurt with the garlic, mint and salt.
Chill and serve with flatbread.

recipes.title: Black Bean Dip
steps: Blend everything until smooth.
Serve with tortilla chips or vegetables.

recipes.title: French Onion Yogurt Dip
steps: Cook the onions slowly in the butter for 20 minutes until deep golden, then cool.
Stir into the yogurt and sour cream with the Worcestershire and salt.
Chill 1 hour and serve with chips.

recipes.title: Tomato and Ricotta Crostini
steps: Brush the bread with oil and toast at 200°C (400°F) for 5 minutes.
Spread with ricotta, top with tomatoes and basil.
Drizzle with balsamic glaze and sprinkle with salt.

recipes.title: Mushroom Crostini with Thyme
steps: Toast the bread slices.
Fry the mushrooms in the butter with the garlic and thyme for 8 minutes until browned.
Spread the toasts with goat cheese and pile the mushrooms on top.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon Cucumber Bites
steps: Mix the cream cheese with the dill and a squeeze of lemon.
Spread on the cucumber slices.
Top with a fold of smoked salmon and a little more dill.

recipes.title: Prosciutto-Wrapped Melon
steps: Wrap each melon wedge with a slice of prosciutto.
Sprinkle with pepper and tuck in a mint leaf.

recipes.title: Bacon-Wrapped Dates
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Stuff the dates with goat cheese if using, wrap each in half a bacon slice and secure with a toothpick.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes until the bacon is crisp.

recipes.title: Sweet and Sour Party Meatballs
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Mix the beef, egg, breadcrumbs, onion and salt and roll into 30 small balls.
Bake on a lined tray 15 minutes.
Warm the chili sauce and jelly in a pan until smooth, add the meatballs and simmer 10 minutes.
Serve with toothpicks.

recipes.title: Mini Caprese Tartlets
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Cut the pastry into 12 squares and press into a muffin tin.
Add a little pesto, mozzarella and tomato to each.
Bake 12 minutes until puffed and golden.

recipes.title: Cheese and Herb Gougeres
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Bring the water, milk, butter and salt to a boil, tip in the flour and beat over the heat 1 minute until it forms a ball.
Cool 5 minutes, then beat in the eggs one at a time, then the cheese and chives.
Pipe or spoon small mounds on a lined tray and bake 22 to 25 minutes until puffed and golden.

recipes.title: Spicy Shrimp Skewers
steps: Toss the shrimp with the oil, Cajun seasoning and garlic and thread onto skewers.
Grill or griddle 2 to 3 minutes a side until pink.
Squeeze over lemon.

recipes.title: Chicken Satay Skewers
steps: Marinate the chicken in the soy sauce, curry powder, turmeric, sugar and oil for 20 minutes.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill or broil 4 to 5 minutes a side until charred and cooked.
Serve with peanut sauce.

recipes.title: Antipasto Skewers
steps: Thread the tortellini, salami, mozzarella, olives and tomatoes onto small skewers.
Drizzle with dressing just before serving.

recipes.title: Halloumi Fries
steps: Toss the halloumi in the flour and paprika.
Fry in the oil 1 to 2 minutes a side until golden (or air fry at 200°C/400°F for 8 minutes).
Drizzle with honey and scatter with pomegranate.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pakoras
steps: Whisk the chickpea flour, spices and salt with the water to a thick batter.
Stir in the vegetables.
Fry spoonfuls in 2 cm hot oil for 3 to 4 minutes, turning, until crisp; drain.
Serve with chutney or raita.

recipes.title: Corn Fritters
steps: Mix the flour, baking powder, paprika and salt, then the egg and milk to a thick batter.
Fold in the corn and green onions.
Fry spoonfuls in the oil 2 to 3 minutes a side until golden.
Serve with sour cream or sweet chili sauce.

recipes.title: Zucchini Feta Fritters
steps: Mix the zucchini, feta, green onions, dill, egg, flour and pepper.
Fry spoonfuls in the oil 3 minutes a side until golden.
Serve with tzatziki or yogurt.

recipes.title: Sausage Rolls
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Mix the sausage meat with the onion and sage.
Cut the pastry in half lengthways, lay a log of sausage along each, roll up and seal.
Cut into short lengths, brush with egg and bake 22 to 25 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Mini Chicken Sliders
steps: Mix the chicken, breadcrumbs, garlic powder, paprika and salt and shape 12 small patties.
Fry 4 to 5 minutes a side until cooked, adding the cheese for the last minute.
Assemble in the buns with mayonnaise and lettuce.

recipes.title: Crispy Potato Skins
steps: Bake the potatoes at 200°C (400°F) for 1 hour, then halve and scoop out most of the flesh (save it for mash).
Brush the skins with oil and bake 10 minutes until crisp.
Fill with cheese and bacon and bake 5 minutes more.
Top with sour cream and green onions.

recipes.title: Spring Onion Pancakes
steps: Mix the flour and hot water into a dough, knead 5 minutes and rest 20 minutes.
Divide into 4, roll each thin, brush with sesame oil, sprinkle with salt and green onions, roll up into a rope, coil and roll flat again.
Fry in the vegetable oil 3 minutes a side until crisp and golden.
Cut into wedges and serve with soy sauce mixed with vinegar.

recipes.title: Vegetable Summer Rolls
steps: Dip a rice paper wrapper in warm water for a few seconds until just soft.
Lay on a damp board, add a little of each filling and roll up tightly, folding in the sides.
Repeat and serve with peanut sauce.

recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Energy Bites
steps: Blitz everything in a food processor until it clumps together when pressed (add a teaspoon of water if dry).
Roll into walnut-sized balls with damp hands.
Chill 30 minutes. Keep in the fridge for up to a week.

recipes.title: Coconut Date Bites
steps: Blitz everything in a food processor until it clumps together when pressed (add a teaspoon of water if dry).
Roll into walnut-sized balls with damp hands.
Chill 30 minutes. Keep in the fridge for up to a week.

recipes.title: Lemon Cashew Bites
steps: Blitz everything in a food processor until it clumps together when pressed (add a teaspoon of water if dry).
Roll into walnut-sized balls with damp hands.
Chill 30 minutes. Keep in the fridge for up to a week.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake Energy Bites
steps: Blitz everything in a food processor until it clumps together when pressed (add a teaspoon of water if dry).
Roll into walnut-sized balls with damp hands.
Chill 30 minutes. Keep in the fridge for up to a week.

recipes.title: Almond Apricot Bites
steps: Blitz everything in a food processor until it clumps together when pressed (add a teaspoon of water if dry).
Roll into walnut-sized balls with damp hands.
Chill 30 minutes. Keep in the fridge for up to a week.

recipes.title: Brownie Bites (No-Bake)
steps: Blitz everything in a food processor until it clumps together when pressed (add a teaspoon of water if dry).
Roll into walnut-sized balls with damp hands.
Chill 30 minutes. Keep in the fridge for up to a week.

recipes.title: Rosemary Roasted Almonds
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (320°F).
Toss everything together and spread on a lined tray in one layer.
Roast 15 minutes, stirring halfway, until fragrant and toasted; they crisp more as they cool.
Cool completely and store in an airtight jar.

recipes.title: Honey Cinnamon Roasted Walnuts
steps: Heat the oven to 170°C (335°F).
Toss everything together and spread on a lined tray in one layer.
Roast 12 minutes, stirring halfway, until fragrant and toasted; they crisp more as they cool.
Cool completely and store in an airtight jar.

recipes.title: Spicy Roasted Pumpkin Seeds
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (320°F).
Toss everything together and spread on a lined tray in one layer.
Roast 15 minutes, stirring halfway, until fragrant and toasted; they crisp more as they cool.
Cool completely and store in an airtight jar.

recipes.title: Ranch Roasted Chickpeas
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (390°F).
Toss everything together and spread on a lined tray in one layer.
Roast 30 minutes, stirring halfway, until fragrant and toasted and crunchy.
Cool completely and store in an airtight jar.

recipes.title: Curry Roasted Cashews
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (320°F).
Toss everything together and spread on a lined tray in one layer.
Roast 12 minutes, stirring halfway, until fragrant and toasted; they crisp more as they cool.
Cool completely and store in an airtight jar.

recipes.title: Smoky Paprika Mixed Nuts
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (320°F).
Toss everything together and spread on a lined tray in one layer.
Roast 14 minutes, stirring halfway, until fragrant and toasted; they crisp more as they cool.
Cool completely and store in an airtight jar.

recipes.title: Kale Chips
steps: Heat the oven to 150°C (300°F).
Massage the oil into the dry kale and spread on two trays without overlapping.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes until crisp but still green.
Sprinkle with salt and nutritional yeast.

recipes.title: Homemade Pita Chips
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F).
Toss the pita with the oil, za'atar and salt.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes, turning once, until crisp.

recipes.title: Baked Tortilla Chips
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F).
Toss the wedges with the oil and lime zest and spread on trays.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes until crisp and lightly golden.
Sprinkle with salt.

recipes.title: Parmesan Crisps
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Drop tablespoons of parmesan onto a lined tray, flatten slightly and sprinkle with pepper and thyme.
Bake 5 to 6 minutes until golden and lacy.
Cool on the tray until crisp.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Sugar Popcorn
steps: Heat the oil with 3 kernels in a large lidded pan; when they pop add the rest and cover.
Shake the pan while it pops, then take off the heat when popping slows.
Toss with the butter, sugar and cinnamon.

recipes.title: Spicy Lime Popcorn
steps: Pop the kernels in the oil in a covered pan, shaking often.
Toss with the lime zest, chili powder and salt while hot.

recipes.title: Trail Mix
steps: Mix everything together.
Store in an airtight jar and portion into small bags for hikes and lunch boxes.

recipes.title: Apple Slices with Peanut Butter Dip
steps: Stir the peanut butter, yogurt, honey and cinnamon until smooth.
Serve with the apple slices (toss them in a little lemon juice if not eating straight away).

recipes.title: Cucumber Sushi Bites

ingredients.name: Cooked rice, seasoned with 1 tbsp rice vinegar

steps: Scoop a little out of the top of each cucumber slice.
Top with a small mound of rice, then salmon and avocado.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve with soy sauce.

recipes.title: Hard-Boiled Egg Snack Plates
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 to 10 minutes, then cool in cold water and peel.
Halve and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Arrange on plates with the vegetables, cheese and crackers.

recipes.title: Ants on a Log
steps: Fill the celery pieces with peanut butter.
Dot with raisins. A good one for kids to make themselves.

recipes.title: Roasted Seaweed Rice Crackers
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Mix the rice, nori, sesame oil, seeds and salt.
Press very thinly between two sheets of parchment and peel off the top sheet.
Bake 15 minutes until crisp, then break into pieces.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Add the oil, onion, carrot and celery and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until the onion softens. Stir in the garlic and thyme for 30 seconds.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the chicken thighs and bay leaf.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 8 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Lift out the chicken, shred it with two forks and discard the bay leaf.
Select Sauté, bring the soup to a boil, add the noodles and cook for 5 to 6 minutes until tender.
Return the chicken, season with salt and pepper and stir in the parsley.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Split Pea Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Add the oil, onion, carrot and celery and cook for 5 minutes, then stir in the garlic and thyme.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the rinsed split peas, bay leaf and ham hock if using; do not fill the pot above the half line because split peas foam.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 15 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Remove the bay leaf and the ham hock (pull the meat off the bone and return it).
Stir well; the peas break down as they cool. Thin with water if needed and season to taste.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Lentil Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Add the oil, onion, carrot and celery and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in the garlic, cumin and paprika for 30 seconds.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the lentils and tomatoes but do not stir the tomatoes in; leaving them on top helps prevent a burn warning.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 12 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts.
Add a squeeze of lemon and season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Minestrone
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Add the oil, onion, carrot and celery and cook for 5 minutes, then stir in the garlic and oregano.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the zucchini, beans and pasta, then pour the tomatoes over the top without stirring.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 4 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Stir in the spinach and let it wilt for a minute.
Season and serve topped with parmesan if you like.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Black Bean Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Add the oil, onion and pepper and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in the garlic, cumin and oregano.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the unsoaked black beans and bay leaf.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 35 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Discard the bay leaf. Blend about a third of the soup with a stick blender to thicken it.
Season with salt and lime juice, and serve with cilantro and sour cream.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Potato Leek Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Melt the butter and cook the leeks for 5 to 6 minutes until soft but not brown. Stir in the garlic and thyme.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the potatoes.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 8 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Blend until smooth with a stick blender.
Stir in the cream, season, and top with chives.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Tomato Basil Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Melt the butter and cook the onion for 4 minutes, then add the garlic.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the sugar and half the basil, then pour the tomatoes on top without stirring.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 6 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Add the rest of the basil and blend until smooth.
Stir in the cream and season.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Butternut Squash Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Add the oil and cook the onion and apple for 4 minutes.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the squash, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 10 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Blend until smooth.
Stir in the coconut milk, season, and top with toasted pumpkin seeds.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken Tortilla Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion and jalapeno for 4 minutes. Stir in the garlic, cumin and chili powder.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the chicken, beans and corn, then pour the tomatoes on top.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 10 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Shred the chicken in the pot with two forks.
Season with lime juice and salt, and top each bowl with avocado, crushed tortilla chips and cilantro.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Beef and Barley Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and brown the beef in two batches, about 3 minutes per batch. Add the onion, carrot, celery and garlic and cook for 3 minutes, then stir in the tomato paste and thyme.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the barley and mushrooms.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 25 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 15 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Season with salt and pepper; the barley keeps thickening the soup as it stands.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken and Wild Rice Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Melt the butter and cook the onion, carrot and celery for 5 minutes, then the garlic and thyme for 30 seconds.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the wild rice and chicken.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 25 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Shred the chicken.
Whisk the cornstarch into the cream, stir it in and simmer on Sauté for 2 to 3 minutes until thickened. Season to taste.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Red Lentil Soup
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Heat the oil and cook the onion and carrot for 4 minutes. Stir in the garlic, tomato paste, cumin and paprika for 1 minute.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the lentils.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 8 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Blend until smooth.
Season, and serve with lemon wedges and a pinch of dried mint.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Ham and Bean Soup

ingredients.name: Dried navy beans, soaked overnight and drained
