steps: Season and fry the chicken in the oil 5 to 6 minutes per side until 75 °C; rest.
Fry the garlic for 30 seconds, add the stock, lemon juice and butter and bubble 2 minutes.
Wilt the spinach in the sauce and spoon over the chicken.

recipes.title: Creamy Tuscan Shrimp
steps: Sear the shrimp in the oil 1 minute per side and lift out.
Fry the garlic and tomatoes, add the cream and parmesan and simmer 3 minutes.
Add the spinach and shrimp and warm through.

recipes.title: Gnocchi with Sausage and Peppers
steps: Fry the sausage meat, breaking it up, until browned.
Add the peppers and onion and cook 6 minutes.
Stir in the passata. Boil the gnocchi until they float and toss them in.

recipes.title: Pesto Chicken Pasta with Tomatoes
steps: Cook the pasta.
Fry the chicken in the oil 7 to 8 minutes until cooked.
Add the tomatoes for 2 minutes, then the drained pasta, pesto and a splash of pasta water. Top with parmesan.

recipes.title: Chorizo and Chickpea Skillet
steps: Fry the chorizo in the oil until it releases its oil.
Add the chickpeas, tomatoes and paprika and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.

recipes.title: Quick Beef Bulgogi Bowls
steps: Start the rice. Mix the beef with the soy, sugar, sesame oil, garlic and pear for 10 minutes.
Cook in a very hot pan in batches, 2 minutes each.
Serve over rice with spring onions.

recipes.title: Salmon with Lemon Dill Yogurt
steps: Boil the potatoes 15 minutes.
Fry the salmon skin side down in the oil 4 minutes, turn and cook 2 to 3 minutes.
Mix the yogurt with dill, lemon zest and juice and salt and serve with the fish and potatoes.

recipes.title: Pork Chops with Apples and Onions
steps: Season and fry the chops in the oil 4 minutes per side until 63 °C; rest.
Fry the apples and onion 5 minutes.
Add the juice and mustard, bubble 2 minutes and spoon over the chops.

recipes.title: Thai Red Curry Noodles
steps: Soak the noodles in boiling water as the pack says.
Fry the paste in a splash of coconut milk, add the chicken and cook 4 minutes.
Add the rest of the milk, pepper and fish sauce and simmer 5 minutes. Toss with noodles and lime.

recipes.title: Spicy Sausage Orzo
steps: Brown the sausage with the onion.
Add the orzo, tomatoes, stock and chili, cover and simmer 12 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in the spinach.

recipes.title: Egg Fried Noodles with Greens
steps: Cook the noodles and drain.
Scramble the eggs in the oil, add garlic and bok choy and stir-fry 2 minutes.
Toss in the noodles and sauces.

recipes.title: Cajun Shrimp and Sausage Skillet
steps: Fry the sausage in the oil 3 minutes.
Add the onion and pepper for 5 minutes.
Add the shrimp and seasoning and cook 3 minutes until pink.

recipes.title: Tortellini with Brown Butter and Peas
steps: Cook the tortellini, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes.
Brown the butter until nutty.
Toss with the drained pasta, lemon zest and parmesan.

recipes.title: Moroccan-Spiced Lamb Pitas
steps: Fry the lamb with the spice and a pinch of salt until browned, 8 minutes.
Mix the yogurt, cucumber and mint.
Fill warm pitas with lamb and yogurt.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Salmon Rice Bowls
steps: Start the rice. Fry the salmon 4 minutes skin side down and 2 minutes on the other side.
Pour in the teriyaki and bubble until glossy.
Serve over rice with cucumber, avocado and sesame.

recipes.title: Mushroom Stroganoff with Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles.
Fry the onion and mushrooms in the butter 8 minutes until golden.
Stir in the paprika and sour cream with a splash of water and toss with the noodles.

recipes.title: Steak Tacos with Lime Onions
steps: Toss the onion with the juice of 1 lime and a pinch of salt.
Season the steak with cumin and salt and sear 3 minutes per side; rest and slice.
Fill warm tortillas with steak, onions and coriander.

recipes.title: Thai Yellow Sweet Potato and Spinach Coconut Curry
steps: Heat the oil and fry any seeds, leaves or curry paste for 1 minute, then add the onion and cook 6 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger and spices and cook 1 minute.
Add the firmer vegetables (and lentils), the coconut milk and stock with 1 tsp salt. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes until tender.
Add the leafy greens, peas or beans for the last 5 minutes. Finish with lime if using and serve with rice.

steps: Roast the chickpeas with the oil, spice and salt at 210 °C for 25 minutes.
Cook the bulgur.
Thin the tahini with lemon and water.
Build bowls with bulgur, chopped salad, chickpeas and tahini.

recipes.title: Miso Glazed Tofu Rice Bowls
steps: Start the rice. Mix the miso, maple and vinegar.
Fry the tofu until golden, brush with the glaze and cook 1 minute more per side.
Serve over rice with cucumber and edamame.

recipes.title: Black Bean Burrito Bowls
steps: Cook the rice and stir in lime juice.
Warm the beans with cumin and salt.
Build bowls with rice, beans, corn, avocado and salsa.

recipes.title: Lentil Tabbouleh Bowls
steps: Simmer the lentils 20 to 25 minutes until just tender; drain.
Chop the herbs, tomatoes and cucumber finely.
Toss everything with lemon juice, oil and salt.

recipes.title: Sesame Soba Noodle Bowls
steps: Cook the soba, rinse in cold water.
Whisk the tahini, soy, vinegar and maple with 2 tbsp water.
Toss the noodles with the sauce and vegetables.

recipes.title: Harissa Roasted Vegetable Couscous
steps: Roast the chopped vegetables and chickpeas with the harissa and oil at 210 °C for 25 minutes.
Pour 300 ml boiling water over the couscous, cover 5 minutes and fluff.
Toss together.

recipes.title: Peanut Tempeh Noodle Bowls
steps: Fry the tempeh until golden.
Soak the noodles.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy, lime and maple with warm water.
Toss everything together.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Quinoa Bowls with Feta
steps: Cook the quinoa and cool slightly.
Chop the vegetables.
Toss with olives, lemon, oil and salt and crumble over the feta.

recipes.title: Chickpea and Sweet Potato Patties
steps: Mash the chickpeas and sweet potato flesh with the spice, coriander and salt.
Mix in the breadcrumbs and shape 8 patties.
Fry in the oil 3 to 4 minutes per side until crisp.

recipes.title: Lentil Walnut Burgers
steps: Pulse the walnuts and oats fine, then add the lentils, onion, soy and paprika and pulse to a rough mix.
Shape 4 patties and chill 15 minutes.
Fry 4 minutes per side and serve in buns.

recipes.title: Mushroom and Lentil Shepherd's Pie (Vegan)
steps: Boil and mash the potatoes with 2 tbsp oil and salt.
Fry the onion, carrot and mushrooms in the rest of the oil 10 minutes, add the paste, lentils and stock and simmer 10 minutes.
Top with mash and bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetable Lasagna with Zucchini and Spinach
steps: Layer sauce, sheets, zucchini, spinach and ricotta three times.
Finish with sauce, mozzarella and parmesan.
Cover and bake at 190 °C for 30 minutes, uncover for 15.

recipes.title: White Bean and Kale Stew
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil.
Add the tomatoes, beans, stock and rosemary and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the kale for 5 minutes and mash a few beans to thicken.

recipes.title: Tofu Tikka Masala
steps: Toss the tofu with the yogurt and half the paste and grill until charred.
Fry the onion in the oil with the rest of the paste.
Add the passata and cream, simmer 10 minutes and add the tofu.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Steaks with Chimichurri
steps: Brush the cauliflower with 1 tbsp oil and salt and roast at 220 °C for 25 minutes, turning once.
Chop the parsley and garlic and mix with the vinegar, chili and the rest of the oil.
Spoon over the steaks.

recipes.title: Eggplant and Tomato Bake with Feta
steps: Brush the eggplant with oil and roast at 220 °C for 20 minutes.
Simmer the tomatoes, garlic and oregano 10 minutes.
Layer in a dish, crumble over feta and bake 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegan Mushroom Bourguignon
steps: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Fry the onions and carrots 5 minutes, stir in the flour and paste.
Add the stock, soy, thyme and mushrooms and simmer 30 minutes until thick.

recipes.title: Spiced Lentil and Spinach Soup (Vegan)
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil, add the curry powder.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and stock and simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in the spinach.

recipes.title: Butternut Squash Mac and Cheese
steps: Simmer the squash in the milk 15 minutes until soft and blend smooth.
Cook the macaroni.
Stir the cheese, mustard and butter into the squash sauce and toss with the pasta.

recipes.title: Vegan Black Bean Chili with Sweet Potato
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in the oil, stir in the spices.
Add the sweet potato, beans and tomatoes with 250 ml water and simmer 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Paneer Bhurji Wraps
steps: Fry the onion and chili in the oil 5 minutes, add the tomatoes and spices for 3 minutes.
Stir in the paneer and cook 3 minutes.
Wrap in warm flatbreads.

recipes.title: Vegetable Korma with Cashews
steps: Blend the cashews with the coconut milk.
Fry the onion in the oil with the paste.
Add the vegetables and cashew milk and simmer 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Spanakorizo (Spinach Rice)
steps: Soften the onions in the oil.
Add the rice and 500 ml water and simmer 10 minutes.
Add the spinach and dill, cover and cook 8 minutes. Finish with lemon.

recipes.title: Mujadara (Lentils and Rice with Crispy Onions)
steps: Fry the onions in the oil over medium heat 25 minutes until deep brown.
Simmer the lentils 15 minutes, add the rice, cumin and half the onions with 500 ml water and cook 15 minutes.
Top with the rest of the onions.

recipes.title: Carrot Spice Muffins (by Weight)
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan) and line a 12-hole muffin tin. Set a bowl on the scale and weigh as you go.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt and sugar (and any ground almonds, oats or spice).
Weigh the milk and oil into a jug, then beat in the eggs. Pour onto the dry mix with the fruit, veg, nuts or chips and fold just until no dry flour shows.
Divide between the cases (about 75 g each) and bake 20 to 22 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.

recipes.title: Apple Crumble Muffins (by Weight)
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan) and line a 12-hole muffin tin. Set a bowl on the scale and weigh as you go.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt and sugar (and any ground almonds, oats or spice).
Weigh the milk and oil into a jug, then beat in the eggs. Pour onto the dry mix with the fruit, veg, nuts or chips and fold just until no dry flour shows.
Divide between the cases (about 75 g each) and bake 20 to 22 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.

recipes.title: Zucchini Chocolate Chip Muffins (by Weight)
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan) and line a 12-hole muffin tin. Set a bowl on the scale and weigh as you go.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt and sugar (and any ground almonds, oats or spice).
Weigh the milk and oil into a jug, then beat in the eggs. Pour onto the dry mix with the fruit, veg, nuts or chips and fold just until no dry flour shows.
Divide between the cases (about 75 g each) and bake 20 to 22 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.

recipes.title: Orange Almond Muffins (by Weight)
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan) and line a 12-hole muffin tin. Set a bowl on the scale and weigh as you go.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt and sugar (and any ground almonds, oats or spice).
Weigh the milk and oil into a jug, then beat in the eggs. Pour onto the dry mix with the fruit, veg, nuts or chips and fold just until no dry flour shows.
Divide between the cases (about 75 g each) and bake 20 to 22 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.

recipes.title: Peach Ginger Muffins (by Weight)
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan) and line a 12-hole muffin tin. Set a bowl on the scale and weigh as you go.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt and sugar (and any ground almonds, oats or spice).
Weigh the milk and oil into a jug, then beat in the eggs. Pour onto the dry mix with the fruit, veg, nuts or chips and fold just until no dry flour shows.
Divide between the cases (about 75 g each) and bake 20 to 22 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.

recipes.title: Rosemary Olive Oil Crackers
steps: Mix everything into a firm dough and rest 30 minutes.
Roll very thin between baking paper, score into squares and prick.
Bake at 180 °C for 20 to 25 minutes until crisp.

recipes.title: Same-Day Crusty White Loaf
steps: Mix to a shaggy dough, rest 20 minutes, then knead 8 minutes.
Rise 1½ hours until doubled. Shape into a round and rise 45 minutes on a floured tray.
Slash and bake at 230 °C for 30 to 35 minutes, until it sounds hollow underneath.

recipes.title: Overnight No-Knead Bread
steps: Stir everything into a wet dough, cover and leave 12 to 18 hours at room temperature.
Fold into a ball on a floured counter and rest 1 hour.
Bake in a preheated lidded pot at 240 °C for 30 minutes, then 15 uncovered.

recipes.title: Whole Wheat Sandwich Bread
steps: Mix and knead 10 minutes until smooth.
Rise 1 hour, shape into a 900 g loaf tin and rise 45 minutes.
Bake at 200 °C for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Rosemary Focaccia (by Weight)
steps: Mix the flour, water, yeast and salt into a sticky dough. Fold it over itself 4 times, 15 minutes apart.
Rise 1 hour, then tip into an oiled tin, dimple with oily fingers and rise 45 minutes.
Top with rosemary and a pinch more salt and bake at 220 °C for 22 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Milk Bread Rolls (Tangzhong)
steps: Cook 25 g of the flour with 125 g of the milk, whisking, until a thick paste; cool.
Knead it with everything else for 10 minutes until smooth.
Rise 1 hour, divide into 12 balls (about 55 g each), rise 40 minutes and bake at 180 °C for 18 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies (by Weight)
steps: Brown the butter until nutty, then cool 10 minutes.
Whisk in the sugars, egg and vanilla, then the flour, soda and salt, then the chocolate.
Scoop 50 g balls and chill 30 minutes. Bake at 180 °C for 10 to 11 minutes.

recipes.title: Oat and Raisin Cookies (by Weight)
steps: Beat the butter and sugar, then the egg.
Mix in everything else.
Scoop 40 g balls onto lined trays and bake at 180 °C for 12 to 13 minutes.

recipes.title: Almond Flour Shortbread
steps: Rub everything together into a dough.
Press into a 20 cm tin and prick.
Bake at 160 °C for 25 minutes; cut while warm.

recipes.title: Lemon Drizzle Loaf (by Weight)
steps: Beat the butter and sugar, then the eggs one by one, then fold in the flour and lemon zest.
Bake in a lined 900 g loaf tin at 180 °C for 40 to 45 minutes.
Mix the lemon juice with the powdered sugar and pour over the hot cake.

recipes.title: Chocolate Olive Oil Cake
steps: Whisk the dry ingredients.
Whisk in the oil, hot water, vanilla and vinegar until smooth.
Bake in a lined 20 cm tin at 180 °C for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Sugar Scones (by Weight)
steps: Rub the butter into the flour, sugar and cinnamon.
Mix in the milk to a soft dough.
Pat 3 cm thick, cut 8 rounds, brush with egg and bake at 220 °C for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese and Chive Scones
steps: Rub the butter into the flour with a pinch of salt.
Stir in most of the cheese, the chives and milk.
Pat 3 cm thick, cut 8 rounds, brush with egg, top with the rest of the cheese and bake at 220 °C for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Soft Pretzels (by Weight)
steps: Knead the flour, water, yeast, salt and butter 8 minutes and rise 1 hour.
Divide into 8 (about 105 g), roll into ropes and twist.
Dip each in 2 litres simmering water with the soda for 30 seconds.
Brush with egg, sprinkle with a little extra salt and bake at 220 °C for 12 to 14 minutes.

recipes.title: Pizza Dough (by Weight)
steps: Mix and knead 8 minutes until smooth.
Rise 2 hours (or overnight in the fridge).
Divide into 4 balls of about 210 g, rest 30 minutes, stretch thin and bake at the hottest oven setting for 8 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Brioche Burger Buns
steps: Knead the flour, yeast, sugar, salt, 3 of the eggs and the milk 8 minutes, then knead in the butter.
Rise 1½ hours, divide into 8 balls (about 110 g) and rise 1 hour.
Brush with the last egg, beaten, and bake at 190 °C for 15 to 18 minutes.

recipes.title: Flapjacks (by Weight)
steps: Melt the butter, sugar and syrup.
Stir in the oats and salt and press into a lined 20 cm tin.
Bake at 180 °C for 20 to 25 minutes; cut while warm.

recipes.title: Ghanaian Kelewele (Spiced Plantains)
steps: Toss the plantain with the ginger, onion, spices and salt and leave 15 minutes.
Fry in hot oil in batches 3 to 4 minutes until deep golden.

recipes.title: Peruvian Papa a la Huancaína

ingredients.name: Green chilies (aji amarillo if you can find them)

steps: Boil and slice the potatoes.
Blend the cheese, chilies, milk and crackers until smooth and thick.
Pour over the potatoes and top with egg and olives.

recipes.title: Nepali Momo with Tomato Achar
steps: Mix the chicken, onion, ginger, garlic, coriander and salt.
Fill and pleat the wrappers.
Steam 12 to 15 minutes.
Char the tomatoes and chili, blend with toasted sesame and salt for the achar.

recipes.title: Nepali Aloo Tama-Style Potato Stew
steps: Fry the onion with the spices in the oil.
Add the tomatoes, potatoes, bamboo shoots, peas and 800 ml water.
Simmer 25 minutes until the potatoes are soft.

recipes.title: Norwegian Fiskesuppe (Creamy Fish Soup)
steps: Simmer the sliced carrot and leek in the stock 10 minutes.
Add the cream and fish and poach 5 minutes.
Season and stir in the dill.

recipes.title: Norwegian Fårikål (Lamb and Cabbage)
steps: Layer the lamb and cabbage in a pot, sprinkling each layer with flour, salt and peppercorns.
Add the water, cover and simmer gently 2½ hours.
Serve with boiled potatoes.

recipes.title: Danish Frikadeller
steps: Mix the pork, onion, egg, flour, milk and salt to a soft mix and rest 15 minutes.
Shape oval patties with a wet spoon.
Fry in the butter 5 to 6 minutes per side.

recipes.title: Danish Rye Bread Open Sandwiches with Egg
steps: Butter the bread.
Top with sliced egg, shrimp and a little mayonnaise.
Finish with dill.

recipes.title: Finnish Lohikeitto (Salmon Soup)
steps: Soften the leek in the butter.
Add the potatoes and stock and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the cream and salmon and poach 5 minutes, then stir in the dill.

recipes.title: Egyptian Molokhia-Style Green Soup
steps: Bring the stock to a simmer and stir in the molokhia; cook 5 minutes without boiling hard.
Fry the garlic and coriander in the ghee until golden and stir in.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Australian Lamingtons
steps: Make a sponge from the butter, sugar, eggs and flour and bake in a 20 cm square tin at 180 °C for 25 minutes; cool.
Cut into 16 squares.
Mix the powdered sugar, cocoa and warm milk into an icing.
Dip each square in icing, then roll in coconut.

recipes.title: Australian Anzac Biscuits
steps: Mix the oats, flour, coconut and sugar.
Melt the butter and syrup, stir in the soda with 2 tbsp boiling water and mix into the dry ingredients.
Roll into balls, flatten and bake at 160 °C for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Ukrainian Varenyky with Potato
steps: Knead the flour, egg, water and salt into a dough and rest 30 minutes.
Boil and mash the potatoes with half the onion fried in butter.
Roll thin, cut rounds, fill and seal.
Boil until they float plus 2 minutes and serve with the rest of the fried onion and sour cream.

recipes.title: Ukrainian Syrniki (Cottage Cheese Pancakes)
steps: Mix the cheese, eggs, sugar, vanilla and most of the flour.
Shape into 12 patties and dust with the rest of the flour.
Fry in the oil over medium heat 3 minutes per side. Serve with sour cream.

recipes.title: Singaporean Hainanese Chicken Rice
steps: Poach the chicken with ginger and spring onions in barely simmering water 40 minutes, then plunge into iced water.
Fry the garlic and rice in a little chicken fat or oil and cook in 600 ml of the broth.
Rub the chicken with sesame oil, chop and serve with rice, cucumber and soy.

recipes.title: Singaporean Chili Crab-Style Shrimp
steps: Fry the garlic and ginger in the oil.
Add the shrimp and cook 2 minutes.
Add the sauces and 100 ml water and simmer 3 minutes, then stir in the egg in ribbons.

recipes.title: Uzbek Achichuk Tomato Salad
steps: Salt the onion and rinse after 5 minutes.
Layer with the tomatoes, herbs and chili and season with salt.

recipes.title: Ecuadorian Locro de Papa
steps: Fry the onion, garlic and spices.
Add the potatoes and 1 litre water and simmer 25 minutes, mashing some.
Stir in the milk and half the cheese. Top with avocado and the rest of the cheese.

recipes.title: Chilean Pastel de Choclo
steps: Fry the beef and onions with the spices.
Blend the corn, milk and basil and cook until thick.
Put the beef in a dish with egg and olives, spread the corn on top, sprinkle sugar and bake at 200 °C for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chilean Pebre
steps: Mix everything with salt.
Leave 15 minutes before serving with bread or grilled meat.

recipes.title: Guatemalan Pepián-Style Chicken
steps: Simmer the chicken in water 25 minutes, keeping the broth.
Toast the seeds and chilies, char the tomatoes, tomatillos and onion and blend with 500 ml broth.
Simmer the sauce with the cinnamon 15 minutes, add the chicken and cook 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Swiss Rösti
steps: Grate the potatoes coarsely and season.
Press into a hot pan with half the butter and cook 10 minutes until golden.
Flip using a plate, add the rest of the butter and cook 10 minutes more.

recipes.title: Swiss Älplermagronen
steps: Boil the potatoes and macaroni together until tender; drain.
Warm the cream, stir in the cheese and toss with the pasta.
Fry the onions in butter until golden and scatter over. Serve with applesauce.

recipes.title: Senegalese Thieboudienne-Style Fish and Rice

ingredients.name: Long-grain rice (broken rice if you can find it)

steps: Stuff slits in the fish with blended parsley and garlic and brown it.
Fry the onion and paste, add 1.5 litres water and the vegetables and simmer 20 minutes; add the fish for 10 minutes.
Lift out fish and vegetables and cook the rice in the broth 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Kenyan Githeri
steps: Fry the onion and carrot in the oil, add the curry powder and tomatoes.
Add the corn, beans and 200 ml water and simmer 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Colombian Arroz con Coco
steps: Simmer the coconut milk until it separates and browns.
Add the rice, sugar, raisins, salt and 300 ml water.
Cover and cook on low 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Colombian Ajiaco
steps: Simmer the chicken, onion and corn in 2 litres water 30 minutes; shred the chicken.
Add the potatoes and guascas and simmer 20 minutes until some break down.
Return the chicken and serve with cream, capers and avocado.

recipes.title: Venezuelan Pabellón Criollo
steps: Simmer the beef in water 1½ hours, then shred.
Fry the onion, pepper and garlic, add the tomatoes and beef and simmer 15 minutes.
Serve with rice, warm beans and fried plantain.

recipes.title: Austrian Kaiserschmarrn
steps: Whisk the yolks, milk, flour and sugar; whisk the whites stiff and fold in.
Pour into a buttered pan, scatter raisins and cook 4 minutes; turn in pieces.
Tear into bite-size pieces with two forks, add more butter and caramelise. Dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Austrian Wiener Schnitzel-Style Pork
steps: Season the cutlets, then dip in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry in 1 cm hot oil 2 to 3 minutes per side, shaking the pan so the crumb puffs.
Drain and serve with lemon.

recipes.title: Costa Rican Arroz con Pollo
steps: Poach and shred the chicken or brown it in pieces.
Fry the vegetables with the achiote, add the rice, stock and sauce.
Cover and cook 20 minutes, then stir in the chicken and peas.

recipes.title: Syrian Fattoush Salad
steps: Toast or fry the pita until crisp and break up.
Chop the vegetables and herbs.
Dress with lemon, oil, sumac and salt and toss with the pita.

recipes.title: Salvadoran Pupusas with Curtido
steps: Mix the cabbage, carrot, vinegar, oregano and salt for the curtido and leave 1 hour.
Mix the masa and water to a soft dough.
Fill balls of dough with cheese and beans, flatten and cook on a hot griddle 4 minutes per side.

recipes.title: Palestinian Musakhan
steps: Roast the chicken with oil, allspice and salt at 200 °C for 45 minutes.
Cook the onions slowly in the oil with the sumac 30 minutes.
Spread onions on the breads, top with chicken and pine nuts and bake 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Polish Pierogi Ruskie
steps: Knead the flour, egg, water and salt and rest 30 minutes.
Mash the potatoes with the cheese and half the onion fried in butter.
Roll, cut, fill and seal.
Boil until they float plus 2 minutes; top with the rest of the onion.

recipes.title: Polish Żurek-Style Sour Rye Soup
steps: Simmer the sausage and potatoes in the stock 20 minutes.
Stir in the starter, garlic and marjoram and simmer 5 minutes.
Serve with halved eggs and sliced sausage.

recipes.title: Czech Bramboráky (Potato Pancakes)
steps: Mix the potatoes with the eggs, garlic, flour, marjoram and salt.
Fry thin pancakes in hot oil 3 minutes per side until crisp.

recipes.title: Hungarian Lecsó
steps: Soften the onions in the lard.
Add the peppers and cook 10 minutes, then the tomatoes and paprika for 10 minutes.
Stir in beaten eggs at the end if you like.

recipes.title: Romanian Mămăligă with Cheese and Sour Cream
steps: Bring the salted water to a boil and whisk in the cornmeal.
Cook on low 15 to 20 minutes, stirring, until it pulls from the pan.
Stir in the butter and serve topped with cheese and sour cream.

recipes.title: Bulgarian Shopska Salad
steps: Chop the vegetables and dress with oil, vinegar and salt.
Grate the cheese generously over the top.

recipes.title: Croatian Squid Risotto
steps: Fry the onion, garlic and squid in the oil 5 minutes.
Stir in the rice, then add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 18 minutes.
Stir in the chopped parsley (Croatian cooks often add squid ink for the black version).

recipes.title: Serbian Pljeskavica
steps: Mix the meats, grated onion, garlic, paprika and salt and chill 1 hour.
Shape 4 large thin patties.
Grill 5 to 6 minutes per side and serve in flatbreads with ajvar and onion.

recipes.title: Belgian Stoemp (Mash with Vegetables)
steps: Boil the potatoes and carrots together until soft.
Soften the leek in the butter.
Mash everything with the milk, nutmeg and salt.

recipes.title: Dutch Stamppot with Kale
steps: Boil the potatoes with the kale on top for 20 minutes.
Heat the sausage in simmering water 10 minutes.
Mash the potatoes and kale with butter, milk and salt and serve with sliced sausage.

recipes.title: Icelandic Plokkfiskur (Fish and Potato Hash)
steps: Poach the fish 5 minutes and flake.
Soften the onion in butter, stir in the flour, then the milk to a thick sauce.
Fold in the fish and chopped potatoes and season with pepper.

recipes.title: Argentine Provoleta
steps: Heat a cast-iron pan until very hot.
Cook the cheese 3 to 4 minutes per side until crusty and melting.
Sprinkle with oregano, chili and oil and serve with bread.

recipes.title: Brazilian Pão de Queijo
steps: Bring the milk, oil and salt to a boil and pour onto the tapioca; mix and cool 10 minutes.
Beat in the eggs, then the cheese.
Roll into 20 balls and bake at 200 °C for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Brazilian Feijoada-Style Black Bean Stew
steps: Brown the bacon, pork and sausage, then the onion and garlic.
Add the drained beans, bay and 2 litres water and simmer 2 hours until creamy.
Serve with rice, greens and orange slices.

recipes.title: Bolivian Salteñas-Style Baked Empanadas
steps: Make a dough of the flour, butter, raw egg, water and salt and rest 30 minutes.
Cook the beef, potatoes, peas and spices with a little water until thick and cool.
Fill rounds of dough with filling and chopped egg, seal with a rope edge.
Bake at 200 °C for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Paraguayan Sopa Paraguaya (Corn Bread)
steps: Soften the onions in half the butter.
Beat the eggs, mix in the cornmeal, milk, crumbled cheese, onions, the rest of the butter, melted, baking powder and salt.
Bake in a greased dish at 190 °C for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Uruguayan Chivito Sandwich
steps: Sear the steaks 1 minute per side, top with ham and cheese to melt.
Fry the eggs.
Fill the rolls with mayonnaise, lettuce, tomato, steak and egg.

recipes.title: Honduran Baleadas
steps: Warm the tortillas and the beans.
Spread with beans, sprinkle with cheese, add sour cream and egg and avocado if using.
Fold in half.

recipes.title: Nicaraguan Vigorón
steps: Boil the cassava 20 to 25 minutes until tender.
Toss the cabbage, tomato and onion with the vinegar and salt.
Serve cassava topped with salad and pork rinds.

recipes.title: Panamanian Sancocho
steps: Simmer the chicken, onion, garlic and oregano in 2 litres water 30 minutes.
Add the yam and simmer 20 minutes until soft and slightly thickened.
Stir in the chopped herbs.

recipes.title: Tunisian Lablabi (Chickpea Soup)
steps: Simmer the chickpeas, garlic and cumin in the stock 15 minutes.
Put torn bread in bowls and ladle the soup over.
Top with harissa, lemon, olive oil and a pinch of cumin.

recipes.title: Algerian Chakchouka
steps: Soften the onion and peppers in the oil 10 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, garlic and caraway and cook 10 minutes.
Make hollows, add the eggs, cover and cook 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Tanzanian Chipsi Mayai (Fries Omelette)
steps: Heat the fries in the oil in a nonstick pan.
Pour over the beaten eggs with salt and cook on low until set.
Flip and serve with a tomato and onion salad.

recipes.title: Ugandan Rolex (Chapati Egg Roll)
steps: Beat the eggs with the vegetables and salt.
Cook an omelette in the oil, lay a chapati on top and press.
Flip, roll up and slice.

recipes.title: Cameroonian Ndolé-Style Greens with Peanuts
steps: Boil the peanuts 15 minutes and blend to a paste.
Fry the onions, garlic and ginger, add the paste and 400 ml water and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the greens and shrimp and cook 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Ivorian Attiéké with Grilled Fish
steps: Steam the attiéké 5 minutes and fluff.
Grill the oiled, salted fish 4 minutes per side.
Serve with diced tomato, onion, chili and lime.

recipes.title: Malaysian Nasi Goreng Kampung
steps: Pound the shallots, garlic, chili and shrimp paste and fry until fragrant.
Add the rice and greens and stir-fry over high heat.
Season with soy and top with fried eggs.

recipes.title: Indonesian Gado-Gado
steps: Whisk the peanut butter, kecap manis, lime and warm water into a pourable sauce.
Arrange the vegetables, tofu and eggs on plates.
Pour over the sauce.

recipes.title: Cambodian Lok Lak
steps: Marinate the beef with the oyster sauce, soy and sugar 15 minutes.
Stir-fry over high heat 3 to 4 minutes.
Serve on lettuce, tomato and onion with a dip of lime juice, pepper and salt.

recipes.title: Lao Larb Gai
steps: Cook the chicken in a splash of water, breaking it up, 6 to 8 minutes.
Off the heat, stir in the fish sauce, lime, rice powder, chili and shallots.
Fold in the herbs and serve with lettuce and sticky rice.

recipes.title: Mongolian Tsuivan (Fried Noodles with Beef)
steps: Make a firm dough of flour, water and salt, rest, roll thin and cut into noodles.
Stir-fry the beef and vegetables in the oil 5 minutes, add 150 ml water.
Lay the noodles on top, cover and steam 8 minutes, then toss.

recipes.title: Afghan Bolani (Stuffed Flatbread)
steps: Knead the flour, water and salt and rest 30 minutes.
Mix the mash with the spring onions, coriander, chili and salt.
Roll dough thin, fill half, fold and seal.
Fry in the oil 3 minutes per side.

recipes.title: Armenian Ghapama-Style Stuffed Pumpkin
steps: Cut a lid off the pumpkin and scoop out the seeds.
Mix the rice, fruit, nuts, honey, butter and cinnamon and fill the pumpkin.
Replace the lid and bake at 180 °C for 1½ hours until soft.

recipes.title: Azerbaijani Kuku with Herbs
steps: Chop the herbs and spring onions very finely and mix with the eggs, walnuts and salt.
Melt the butter in a pan, add the mixture and cook covered on low 15 minutes.
Flip and cook 5 minutes more.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Pol Sambol
steps: Rub everything together with your fingers and salt until pink and fragrant.
Serve with rice, curries or bread.

recipes.title: Bangladeshi Bhuna Khichuri
steps: Dry-roast the dal until fragrant and rinse with the rice.
Fry the onion, ginger and spices in the ghee.
Add the rice, dal and 900 ml hot water and cook covered 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Burmese Tomato Curry with Eggs
steps: Fry the eggs in the oil with turmeric until blistered; lift out.
Fry the onions and garlic until golden, add the paprika and tomatoes and cook 15 minutes.
Add the fish sauce and eggs and simmer 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Fijian Kokoda (Coconut Lime Fish)

ingredients.name: White fish fillets, very fresh, cubed

steps: Cover the fish with lime juice and salt and chill 1 to 2 hours until opaque.
Drain, then fold in the coconut cream, tomato, onion and chili.

recipes.title: New Zealand Pavlova with Kiwi
steps: Whisk the whites stiff, then add the sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Fold in the vinegar and cornstarch.
Spread into a 20 cm round on baking paper and bake at 120 °C for 75 minutes; cool in the oven.
Top with whipped cream and fruit.

recipes.title: Samoan Panipopo (Coconut Buns)
steps: Knead the flour, yeast, sugar, milk, egg, butter and salt and rise 1 hour.
Shape 12 buns in a dish and rise 30 minutes.
Pour over the coconut milk mixed with the extra sugar and bake at 180 °C for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Haitian Diri ak Pwa (Rice and Beans)
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in the oil, add the beans with their liquid and simmer 5 minutes.
Add the rice, thyme, whole pepper and water to 2 cm above the rice.
Cover and cook on low 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Dominican Habichuelas Guisadas
steps: Fry the onion, pepper and garlic, then the tomato paste.
Add the beans with some liquid and the pumpkin and simmer 20 minutes, mashing the pumpkin to thicken.
Stir in the coriander.

recipes.title: Guyanese Cook-Up Rice
steps: Brown the chicken with the onion and garlic.
Add the rice, peas, coconut milk, thyme, pepper and 500 ml water.
Cover and cook on low 25 to 30 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid absorbed.

recipes.title: Roasted Cauliflower and Turmeric Soup
steps: Roast the cauliflower and onion with the oil and spices at 210 °C for 25 minutes.
Simmer with the stock and coconut milk 10 minutes and blend.

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken and Wild Rice Soup
steps: Soften the vegetables in the butter.
Add the stock, rice and chicken and simmer 40 minutes; shred the chicken.
Stir in the cream.

recipes.title: Roasted Carrot and Ginger Soup
steps: Roast the carrots and onion in the oil at 210 °C for 25 minutes.
Simmer with the ginger and stock 10 minutes and blend.
Swirl with yogurt.

recipes.title: Thai Pumpkin Coconut Soup
steps: Fry the paste in a splash of coconut milk.
Add the pumpkin, the rest of the milk and stock and simmer 20 minutes.
Blend and finish with lime and coriander.

recipes.title: Greek Chicken Avgolemono Soup
steps: Simmer the orzo in the stock 10 minutes and add the chicken.
Whisk the eggs with the lemon juice and slowly whisk in a ladle of hot stock.
Stir the mixture into the pot off the heat until silky; add dill.

recipes.title: Charred Corn and Tomato Salad
steps: Char the corn in a hot pan or grill and cut off the kernels.
Toss with halved tomatoes, sliced onion, lime and oil.
Top with feta and basil.

recipes.title: Crunchy Asian Slaw with Peanuts
steps: Shred the cabbage and carrots finely.
Whisk the vinegar, soy, oil and honey.
Toss and top with spring onions and peanuts.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt Honey Walnut Bowls
steps: Toast the walnuts.
Spoon the yogurt into bowls and top with walnuts, honey and cinnamon.

recipes.title: No-Bake Chocolate Peanut Butter Bars
steps: Mix the crumbs, butter, peanut butter and sugar and press into a lined 20 cm tin.
Melt the chocolate and spread over.
Chill 2 hours and cut into 16.

recipes.title: Baked Rice Pudding with Nutmeg
steps: Put the rice, milk and sugar in a buttered dish and dot with butter.
Grate over the nutmeg.
Bake at 150 °C for 2 hours, stirring once after 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Thai Holy Basil Chicken Thigh Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: Basil leaves (Thai holy basil if you can find it)

steps: Slice the chicken thigh into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar and 3 tbsp water.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the chicken thigh in two batches, about 4 minutes per batch, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F); tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the onion with the garlic and chilies for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the chicken thigh with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Turn off the heat and stir in the basil until it wilts.
Serve with jasmine rice.

Return the chicken breast with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Turn off the heat and stir in the basil until it wilts.

Return the chicken thigh with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss in the cashews and green spring onion.

recipes.title: Thai Massaman Chicken Thighs Curry
steps: Pat the chicken thighs dry and season well with salt and the curry paste.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the chicken thighs in batches, about 8 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coconut milk, potatoes, onion and 300 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 40 minutes (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat pulls easily from the bone and cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F).
Stir in the fish sauce, sugar and lime juice and scatter with peanuts. Taste for salt.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Massaman Chicken Drumsticks Curry
steps: Pat the chicken drumsticks dry and season well with salt and the curry paste.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the chicken drumsticks in batches, about 8 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coconut milk, potatoes, onion and 300 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 45 minutes (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is tender and pulls from the bone and cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F).
Stir in the fish sauce, sugar and lime juice and scatter with peanuts. Taste for salt.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Red Chicken Thighs Curry
steps: Pat the chicken thighs dry and season well with salt and the curry paste.

Lower the heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coconut milk and 200 ml water, adding the pepper and beans for the last 10 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 40 minutes (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat pulls easily from the bone and cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F).
Season with the fish sauce and sugar and stir in the basil. Taste for salt.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Lemongrass Chicken Thigh Traybake
steps: Mix the lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce, sugar and soy sauce with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the chicken thigh and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to overnight in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Spread on a lined tray in one layer.
Roast for about 25 minutes, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F); for a darker finish, grill the top for the last 2 to 3 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes. Scatter with coriander and serve with lime wedges.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Lemongrass Chicken Breast Traybake
steps: Mix the lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce, sugar and soy sauce with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the chicken breast and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 4 hours in the fridge.

Rest 5 minutes. Scatter with coriander and serve with lime wedges.
Serve with jasmine rice.

steps: Mix the lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce, sugar and soy sauce with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the chicken drumsticks and leave to marinate 1 hour or up to overnight in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 210 °C (190 °C fan). Spread on a lined tray in one layer.

Rest 5 minutes. Scatter with coriander and serve with lime wedges.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Grilled Thai Gai Yang-Style Chicken Thigh
steps: Mix the fish sauce, soy sauce, sugar, coriander, pepper and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the chicken thigh and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to overnight in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Spread on a rack over a lined tray.
Roast for about 25 minutes, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F); for a darker finish, grill the top for the last 2 to 3 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with sweet chili sauce for dipping.

recipes.title: Thai Garlic Pepper Chicken Thigh
steps: Pat the chicken thigh dry and season with salt and the white pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 5 to 6 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and chilies for 1 minute, then the garlic for 1 minute, then add the oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar and 4 tbsp water.
Return the chicken thigh with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the glossy garlic sauce over.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Garlic Pepper Chicken Breast
steps: Pat the chicken breast dry and season with salt and the white pepper.

Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Butterfly or pound to an even 2 cm, then cook 5 to 6 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and chilies for 1 minute, then the garlic for 1 minute, then add the oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar and 4 tbsp water.
Return the chicken breast with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the glossy garlic sauce over.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Larb Chicken Lettuce Cups
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken and the garlic and chilies and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Stir in the lime juice and fish sauce.
Toss with the onion, mint and toasted rice powder and spoon into lettuce leaves.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Basil Chicken Stir-Fry
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken and the garlic and chilies and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Stir in the oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar and 3 tbsp water.
Stir in the basil and serve each portion topped with a fried egg.
Serve with jasmine rice.

ingredients.name: Soy sauce (1 tbsp dark if you have it)

steps: Pat the chicken thighs dry and season well with salt and the star anise and cinnamon.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the chicken thighs in batches, about 8 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Rest 5 minutes. Slice and spoon over the pan juices.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Honey Soy Chicken Thigh Traybake
steps: Mix the soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, ginger and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the chicken thigh and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to overnight in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Spread on a lined tray.
Roast for about 25 minutes, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F); for a darker finish, grill the top for the last 2 to 3 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and the green spring onions.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Honey Soy Chicken Breast Traybake
steps: Mix the soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, ginger and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the chicken breast and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Spread on a lined tray.
Roast for about 22 minutes, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F); for a darker finish, grill the top for the last 2 to 3 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and the green spring onions.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Honey Soy Chicken Drumsticks Traybake
steps: Mix the soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, ginger and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the chicken drumsticks and leave to marinate 1 hour or up to overnight in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 210 °C (190 °C fan). Spread on a lined tray.
Roast for about 40 minutes, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F); for a darker finish, grill the top for the last 2 to 3 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and the green spring onions.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Ginger Scallion Chicken Thigh
steps: Pat the chicken thigh dry and season with salt and white pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 5 to 6 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.

Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 1 minute, then the ginger and spring onions for 1 minute, then add the soy sauce, wine and 4 tbsp water.
Return the chicken thigh with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Drizzle with the sesame oil.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Ginger Scallion Chicken Breast
steps: Pat the chicken breast dry and season with salt and white pepper.

Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Butterfly or pound to an even 2 cm, then cook 5 to 6 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.

Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 1 minute, then the ginger and spring onions for 1 minute, then add the soy sauce, wine and 4 tbsp water.
Return the chicken breast with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Drizzle with the sesame oil.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Mapo-Style Chicken Tofu
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken and the chili bean paste and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Stir in the stock, soy sauce and tofu; simmer 5 minutes, then thicken with the cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water.
Sprinkle with the ground Sichuan pepper and green spring onions.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Lion's Head Chicken Meatballs
steps: Mix the chicken with the egg, soy sauce, wine, cornstarch, ginger and spring onion whites and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 16 balls.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 6 minutes, turning; they finish cooking in the sauce.
Cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Add the stock and cabbage; cover and simmer 20 minutes, until the meat is no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Serve the meatballs in bowls with the cabbage and broth.

recipes.title: Sichuan Cumin Chicken Thigh Stir-Fry
steps: Slice the chicken thigh into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the soy sauce and 2 tbsp water.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the chicken thigh in two batches, about 4 minutes per batch, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F); tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the cumin, chili flakes and onion with the garlic and ginger for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the chicken thigh with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss in the coriander.
Serve with steamed rice.

Return the chicken breast with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss in the coriander.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Sichuan Dry-Fried Chicken Thigh Stir-Fry
steps: Slice the chicken thigh into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the chicken thigh in two batches, about 4 minutes per batch, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F); tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the green beans for 5 minutes until blistered, then the chilies and Sichuan pepper, then with the garlic and ginger for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the chicken thigh with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Serve right away while the beans are crisp.

Return the chicken breast with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Serve right away while the beans are crisp.

recipes.title: Sichuan Fish-Fragrant Chicken Thigh Stir-Fry

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the chicken thigh in two batches, about 4 minutes per batch, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F); tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the eggplant until soft, then with the garlic and ginger for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the chicken thigh with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss until glossy.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Sichuan Fish-Fragrant Chicken Breast Stir-Fry

recipes.title: Sichuan Spicy Bean Paste Braised Chicken Thighs
steps: Pat the chicken thighs dry and season well with salt and the chili bean paste and star anise.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the chicken thighs in batches, about 8 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the soy sauce, daikon and water to just cover, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 40 minutes (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat pulls easily from the bone and cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F).
Scatter with Sichuan pepper and coriander. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Sichuan Spicy Bean Paste Braised Chicken Drumsticks

Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the chicken drumsticks in batches, about 8 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the soy sauce, daikon and water to just cover, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 45 minutes (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is tender and pulls from the bone and cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F).
Scatter with Sichuan pepper and coriander. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

Return the chicken thigh with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the numbing chili sauce over.
Serve with steamed rice.

Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the chili oil, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and 3 tbsp water.
Return the chicken breast with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the numbing chili sauce over.

recipes.title: Sichuan Dan Dan-Style Chicken Noodles
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the garlic and ginger for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken and the ginger and garlic and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Stir in the soy sauce and fry until the meat is crisp.
Divide the sesame paste, chili oil and Sichuan pepper between bowls, add the boiled noodles and bok choy and top with the crispy meat.
Serve with steamed rice.

Return the chicken thigh with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss everything together until hot.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

Lower the heat and cook the garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the dashi, soy sauce, mirin, sugar, potatoes and carrots, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 40 minutes (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat pulls easily from the bone and cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F).
Let it sit 10 minutes so the potatoes soak up the sauce. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Japanese Curry Chicken Thighs Stew
steps: Pat the chicken thighs dry and season well with salt and the onions until golden.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the chicken thighs in batches, about 8 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add 700 ml water, the carrots, potatoes and apple, then stir in the curry roux for the last 10 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 40 minutes (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat pulls easily from the bone and cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F).
Serve over rice. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Japanese Japanese Curry Chicken Drumsticks Stew

Stir in the soy sauce, mirin and sugar and cook until dry and crumbly.

Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

steps: Mix the chicken with the garam masala, cumin, chili powder, coriander, green chili, garlic and ginger and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 8 patties or logs.

Cook the onions, garlic and ginger gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Stir together the yogurt mixed with chopped mint.

Lower the heat and cook the onion, garlic, ginger and curry leaves for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the tamarind and 400 ml water, then the coconut milk for the last 20 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 40 minutes (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat pulls easily from the bone and cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F).

Serve with rice.

Stir-fry the green beans and pepper with the shallots, garlic and chilies for 2 to 3 minutes.

Add the tomatoes blended with the chipotle, then the stock; simmer the meatballs 25 minutes, until the meat is no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Serve as a soupy stew.

Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the tomatoes, beans and stock, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 40 minutes (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat pulls easily from the bone and cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F).

ingredients.name: Green chili (aji amarillo if you can find it)

steps: Pat the chicken thighs dry and season well with salt and ground cumin.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the chicken thighs in batches, about 8 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coriander blended with the chili and beer, then the carrots for the last 30 minutes and the peas for the last 5, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Serve with rice and beans. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: French Cider and Mustard Braised Chicken Thighs
steps: Pat the chicken thighs dry and season well with salt and the thyme.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the chicken thighs in batches, about 8 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the shallots and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the cider and mustard, adding the apples for the last 15 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 40 minutes (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat pulls easily from the bone and cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F).
Stir in the crème fraîche. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: Roast French Dijon Herb Chicken Thigh
steps: Mix the mustard, herbs and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the chicken thigh and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to overnight in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Lay on a lined tray and press on the breadcrumbs mixed with butter.
Roast for about 25 minutes, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F); for a darker finish, grill the top for the last 2 to 3 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with the pan juices.

steps: Pat the chicken thigh dry and season with salt and the crushed peppercorns, pressed on both sides.

Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the shallots and garlic for 1 minute, then the brandy (careful, it can flame), then the cream; bubble 2 minutes.
Return the chicken thigh with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the peppery cream over.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

Scatter with almonds. Taste for salt.
Serve with couscous.

recipes.title: Moroccan Apricot Chicken Drumsticks Tagine
steps: Pat the chicken drumsticks dry and season well with salt and the ras el hanout and cinnamon.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the chicken drumsticks in batches, about 8 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion, garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the apricots, chickpeas, honey and 500 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 45 minutes (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is tender and pulls from the bone and cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F).
Scatter with almonds. Taste for salt.
Serve with couscous.

recipes.title: Moroccan Preserved Lemon and Olive Chicken Thighs Tagine

ingredients.name: Preserved lemons, chopped (or 1 lemon, zested and juiced)

steps: Pat the chicken thighs dry and season well with salt and the turmeric and ginger.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the chicken thighs in batches, about 8 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion, garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the preserved lemon and 400 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 40 minutes (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat pulls easily from the bone and cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F).
Stir in the olives and coriander. Taste for salt.
Serve with couscous.

recipes.title: Moroccan Preserved Lemon and Olive Chicken Drumsticks Tagine

ingredients.name: Preserved lemons, chopped (or 1 lemon, zested and juiced)

steps: Pat the chicken drumsticks dry and season well with salt and the turmeric and ginger.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the chicken drumsticks in batches, about 8 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion, garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the preserved lemon and 400 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 45 minutes (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is tender and pulls from the bone and cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F).
Stir in the olives and coriander. Taste for salt.
Serve with couscous.

recipes.title: Roast Moroccan Chermoula Chicken Thigh
steps: Mix the herbs, cumin, paprika, lemon and garlic blended with oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the chicken thigh and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to overnight in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Lay on a lined tray.
Roast for about 25 minutes, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F); for a darker finish, grill the top for the last 2 to 3 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Roast Moroccan Chermoula Chicken Breast
steps: Mix the herbs, cumin, paprika, lemon and garlic blended with oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the chicken breast and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Lay on a lined tray.
Roast for about 22 minutes, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F); for a darker finish, grill the top for the last 2 to 3 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Roast Moroccan Chermoula Chicken Drumsticks
steps: Mix the herbs, cumin, paprika, lemon and garlic blended with oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the chicken drumsticks and leave to marinate 1 hour or up to overnight in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 210 °C (190 °C fan). Lay on a lined tray.
Roast for about 40 minutes, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F); for a darker finish, grill the top for the last 2 to 3 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Moroccan Kefta Chicken Tagine
steps: Mix the chicken with the cumin, paprika, parsley and half the onion and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 8 patties or logs.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 6 minutes, turning; they finish cooking in the sauce.
Cook the onion, garlic and ginger gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes; simmer the meatballs 15 minutes, then crack in the eggs, cover and cook 6 minutes, until the meat is no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Serve with bread.

recipes.title: American Pot Roast-Style Braised Chicken Thighs
steps: Pat the chicken thighs dry and season well with salt and the thyme and tomato paste.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the chicken thighs in batches, about 8 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the stock, with the carrots and potatoes for the last hour, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 40 minutes (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat pulls easily from the bone and cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F).
Thicken the gravy if you like and serve. Taste for salt.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American Pot Roast-Style Braised Chicken Drumsticks
steps: Pat the chicken drumsticks dry and season well with salt and the thyme and tomato paste.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the chicken drumsticks in batches, about 8 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the stock, with the carrots and potatoes for the last hour, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 45 minutes (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is tender and pulls from the bone and cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F).
Thicken the gravy if you like and serve. Taste for salt.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American BBQ Chicken Thigh Traybake
steps: Mix the paprika, sugar, garlic powder and half the sauce with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the chicken thigh and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to overnight in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Spread on a lined tray, brushing with the rest of the sauce for the last 10 minutes.
Roast for about 25 minutes, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F); for a darker finish, grill the top for the last 2 to 3 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with coleslaw.

recipes.title: American BBQ Chicken Breast Traybake
steps: Mix the paprika, sugar, garlic powder and half the sauce with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the chicken breast and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Spread on a lined tray, brushing with the rest of the sauce for the last 10 minutes.
Roast for about 22 minutes, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F); for a darker finish, grill the top for the last 2 to 3 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with coleslaw.

recipes.title: American BBQ Chicken Drumsticks Traybake
steps: Mix the paprika, sugar, garlic powder and half the sauce with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the chicken drumsticks and leave to marinate 1 hour or up to overnight in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 210 °C (190 °C fan). Spread on a lined tray, brushing with the rest of the sauce for the last 10 minutes.
Roast for about 40 minutes, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F); for a darker finish, grill the top for the last 2 to 3 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with coleslaw.

recipes.title: Roast American Maple Mustard Chicken Thigh
steps: Mix the maple, mustard, vinegar and rosemary with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the chicken thigh and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to overnight in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Lay on a lined tray.
Roast for about 25 minutes, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F); for a darker finish, grill the top for the last 2 to 3 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes. Spoon over the pan juices.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: Roast American Maple Mustard Chicken Breast
steps: Mix the maple, mustard, vinegar and rosemary with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the chicken breast and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Lay on a lined tray.
Roast for about 22 minutes, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F); for a darker finish, grill the top for the last 2 to 3 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes. Spoon over the pan juices.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: Roast American Maple Mustard Chicken Drumsticks
steps: Mix the maple, mustard, vinegar and rosemary with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the chicken drumsticks and leave to marinate 1 hour or up to overnight in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 210 °C (190 °C fan). Lay on a lined tray.
Roast for about 40 minutes, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F); for a darker finish, grill the top for the last 2 to 3 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes. Spoon over the pan juices.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American Honey Garlic Chicken Thigh
steps: Pat the chicken thigh dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 5 to 6 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the garlic for 30 seconds, then the honey, soy sauce and vinegar; bubble until sticky.
Return the chicken thigh with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Turn to coat.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American Honey Garlic Chicken Breast
steps: Pat the chicken breast dry and season with salt and black pepper.

Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Butterfly or pound to an even 2 cm, then cook 5 to 6 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the garlic for 30 seconds, then the honey, soy sauce and vinegar; bubble until sticky.
Return the chicken breast with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Turn to coat.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American Creamy Tuscan-Style Chicken Thigh
steps: Pat the chicken thigh dry and season with salt and the Italian seasoning.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 5 to 6 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the sun-dried tomatoes and garlic, then the cream and parmesan, then the spinach until wilted.
Return the chicken thigh with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon over.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American Creamy Tuscan-Style Chicken Breast
steps: Pat the chicken breast dry and season with salt and the Italian seasoning.

Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Butterfly or pound to an even 2 cm, then cook 5 to 6 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the sun-dried tomatoes and garlic, then the cream and parmesan, then the spinach until wilted.
Return the chicken breast with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon over.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American Sloppy Joe-Style Chicken Sandwiches
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken and the pepper and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Stir in the ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, sugar and 100 ml water and simmer 10 minutes.
Pile onto toasted buns.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: British Ale Chicken Thighs Stew
steps: Pat the chicken thighs dry and season well with salt and the flour and thyme.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the chicken thighs in batches, about 8 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the ale, Worcestershire sauce, bay leaves, carrots and 200 ml stock, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 40 minutes (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat pulls easily from the bone and cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F).
Serve with mash or crusty bread. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: British Ale Chicken Drumsticks Stew
steps: Pat the chicken drumsticks dry and season well with salt and the flour and thyme.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the chicken drumsticks in batches, about 8 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the ale, Worcestershire sauce, bay leaves, carrots and 200 ml stock, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 45 minutes (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is tender and pulls from the bone and cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F).
Serve with mash or crusty bread. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: British Honey Mustard Chicken Thigh Traybake
steps: Mix the mustard, honey, thyme and oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the chicken thigh and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to overnight in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Spread on a tray with the potatoes and parsnips (start the vegetables 15 minutes earlier).
Roast for about 25 minutes, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F); for a darker finish, grill the top for the last 2 to 3 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes. Spoon over the sticky juices.
Serve with mashed potatoes and greens.

recipes.title: British Honey Mustard Chicken Breast Traybake
steps: Mix the mustard, honey, thyme and oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the chicken breast and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Spread on a tray with the potatoes and parsnips (start the vegetables 15 minutes earlier).
Roast for about 22 minutes, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F); for a darker finish, grill the top for the last 2 to 3 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes. Spoon over the sticky juices.
Serve with mashed potatoes and greens.

recipes.title: British Honey Mustard Chicken Drumsticks Traybake
steps: Mix the mustard, honey, thyme and oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the chicken drumsticks and leave to marinate 1 hour or up to overnight in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 210 °C (190 °C fan). Spread on a tray with the potatoes and parsnips (start the vegetables 15 minutes earlier).
Roast for about 40 minutes, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F); for a darker finish, grill the top for the last 2 to 3 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes. Spoon over the sticky juices.
Serve with mashed potatoes and greens.

recipes.title: British Peppercorn Chicken Thigh
steps: Pat the chicken thigh dry and season with salt and the crushed peppercorns.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 5 to 6 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the cream and mustard; bubble 2 minutes.
Return the chicken thigh with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon over and serve with chips or salad.
Serve with mashed potatoes and greens.

recipes.title: British Peppercorn Chicken Breast
steps: Pat the chicken breast dry and season with salt and the crushed peppercorns.

Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Butterfly or pound to an even 2 cm, then cook 5 to 6 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the cream and mustard; bubble 2 minutes.
Return the chicken breast with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon over and serve with chips or salad.
Serve with mashed potatoes and greens.

recipes.title: Thai Holy Basil Beef Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: Beef sirloin, thinly sliced against the grain
Basil leaves (Thai holy basil if you can find it)

steps: Slice the beef into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar and 3 tbsp water.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the beef in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until browned outside but still a little pink inside; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the onion with the garlic and chilies for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the beef with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Turn off the heat and stir in the basil until it wilts.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Cashew Beef Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: Beef sirloin, thinly sliced against the grain

steps: Slice the beef into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar and 3 tbsp water.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the beef in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until browned outside but still a little pink inside; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the pepper and the white parts of the spring onions with the garlic and chilies for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the beef with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss in the cashews and green spring onion.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Ginger Beef Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: Beef sirloin, thinly sliced against the grain

steps: Slice the beef into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce and 3 tbsp water.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the beef in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until browned outside but still a little pink inside; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the ginger, onion and mushrooms with the garlic and chilies for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the beef with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Scatter with coriander if you have it.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Massaman Beef Curry

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the curry paste.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coconut milk, potatoes, onion and 300 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Stir in the fish sauce, sugar and lime juice and scatter with peanuts. Taste for salt.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Massaman Short Ribs Curry
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the curry paste.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coconut milk, potatoes, onion and 300 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Stir in the fish sauce, sugar and lime juice and scatter with peanuts. Taste for salt.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Red Beef Curry

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the curry paste.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coconut milk and 200 ml water, adding the pepper and beans for the last 10 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Season with the fish sauce and sugar and stir in the basil. Taste for salt.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Red Short Ribs Curry
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the curry paste.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coconut milk and 200 ml water, adding the pepper and beans for the last 10 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Season with the fish sauce and sugar and stir in the basil. Taste for salt.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Green Beef Curry
