Add the beans, sausage, bay leaves and stock, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Serve with rice, greens and orange slices. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Brazilian Feijoada-Style Short Ribs Stew
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and black pepper.

recipes.title: Grilled Brazilian Churrasco-Style Flank Steak
steps: Mix the coarse salt and garlic only with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Mix the onion, tomatoes, parsley and vinegar as a vinaigrette salsa.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Slice and serve with the salsa.
Serve with rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Brazilian Acebolado Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and the paprika.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the onion rings in the butter until soft and golden, then the vinegar.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Pile the onions on top.
Serve with rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Grilled Argentine Chimichurri Flank Steak
steps: Mix salt, a little of the oregano and the oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Mix the parsley, garlic, the rest of the oregano, chili, vinegar and oil as chimichurri.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Slice and spoon over the chimichurri.
Serve with roast potatoes or a green salad.

recipes.title: Argentine Salsa Criolla Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Meanwhile, off the heat, mix the onion, pepper, tomatoes, vinegar and oil for the salsa while the meat rests.
Spoon the salsa over.
Serve with roast potatoes or a green salad.

recipes.title: Argentine Carbonada-Style Beef Stew

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and paprika.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the tomatoes and stock, adding the vegetables and fruit for the last 30 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Serve in bowls. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Argentine Carbonada-Style Short Ribs Stew
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and paprika.

recipes.title: Italian Cacciatore Braised Beef

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the oregano and rosemary.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the wine (boil 1 minute), tomatoes, pepper and mushrooms, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Stir in the olives. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the wine, passata, carrot, celery and bay leaves; shred the meat at the end, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Toss with the pasta and serve with parmesan. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Ragù Braised Short Ribs
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the wine, passata, carrot, celery and bay leaves; shred the meat at the end, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Toss with the pasta and serve with parmesan. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Peperonata Braised Beef

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the peppers, tomatoes and vinegar, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Stir in the capers and basil. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Peperonata Braised Short Ribs
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and black pepper.

Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the peppers, tomatoes and vinegar, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Stir in the capers and basil. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Alla Pizzaiola Braised Beef

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the oregano.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the tomatoes and capers, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Stir in the olives and basil. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the oregano.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the tomatoes and capers, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Stir in the olives and basil. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Roast Italian Porchetta-Style Flank Steak
steps: Mix the fennel seeds, rosemary, lemon zest, chili and garlic with oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay in a roasting dish and pour the wine around.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Slice and spoon over the pan juices.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Lemon Rosemary Flank Steak Traybake
steps: Mix the lemon juice, rosemary, garlic and oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Spread on a tray with the potatoes, onion and lemon slices (start the potatoes 15 minutes earlier).
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Spoon over the pan juices.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Piccata Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and black pepper; dust lightly with flour.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the stock, lemon juice and capers and bubble 2 minutes, then swirl in the butter.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Scatter with parsley.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Marsala Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and black pepper; dust lightly with flour.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the mushrooms in the butter until golden, then the Marsala and stock and reduce by half.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the mushrooms and sauce over.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Saltimbocca-Style Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and black pepper; lay a sage leaf and a slice of prosciutto on each piece and press.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the wine and butter and bubble 1 minute.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the buttery sauce over.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Polpette Beef Meatballs
steps: Mix the beef with the egg, breadcrumbs, parmesan, parsley and half the garlic and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 16 balls.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 6 minutes, turning; they finish cooking in the sauce.
Cook the onion and garlic gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Add the passata and simmer the meatballs gently for 20 minutes, until the meat is no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Tear over the basil and serve with bread or pasta.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Bolognese-Style Beef Ragù
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the beef and the carrot and celery and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the wine, then the passata; simmer 30 minutes.
Toss with the pasta and parmesan.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: French Coq au Vin-Style Braised Beef

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the thyme and flour.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the shallots and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the wine, bay leaves and 250 ml stock or water; fry the bacon, mushrooms and onions separately and add for the last 20 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Scatter with parsley. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: French Coq au Vin-Style Braised Short Ribs
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the thyme and flour.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the shallots and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the wine, bay leaves and 250 ml stock or water; fry the bacon, mushrooms and onions separately and add for the last 20 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Scatter with parsley. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: French Provençal Braised Beef

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the herbes de Provence.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the shallots and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the wine, tomatoes and fennel, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Stir in the olives. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: French Provençal Braised Short Ribs
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the herbes de Provence.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the shallots and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the wine, tomatoes and fennel, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Stir in the olives. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: French Cider and Mustard Braised Beef

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the thyme.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the shallots and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the cider and mustard, adding the apples for the last 15 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Stir in the crème fraîche. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: French Cider and Mustard Braised Short Ribs
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the thyme.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the shallots and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the cider and mustard, adding the apples for the last 15 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Stir in the crème fraîche. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: Roast French Dijon Herb Flank Steak
steps: Mix the mustard, herbs and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on a lined tray and press on the breadcrumbs mixed with butter.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with the pan juices.

recipes.title: French Au Poivre Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and the crushed peppercorns, pressed on both sides.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the shallots and garlic for 1 minute, then the brandy (careful, it can flame), then the cream; bubble 2 minutes.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the peppery cream over.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: French Dijon Cream Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the shallots and garlic for 1 minute, then the wine and reduce by half, then the cream and mustard.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Stir in the tarragon and spoon over.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: French Beurre Blanc Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and white pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the shallots and garlic for 1 minute, then the wine and vinegar until almost gone, then whisk in the butter a cube at a time off the heat.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the sauce over and scatter with chives.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: French Steak Haché Beef Patties

ingredients.name: Black pepper, coarsely crushed (or green peppercorns)

steps: Mix the beef with the egg yolk, mustard and half the shallots and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 8 patties or logs.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 8 minutes, turning, until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Cook the shallots and garlic gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Stir together the cream and peppercorns and bubble 2 minutes.
Spoon the sauce over and serve with fries or salad.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: Spanish Chorizo and Chickpea Beef Stew

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the smoked paprika.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the chorizo, tomatoes, chickpeas and 300 ml water, with the spinach at the end, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Drizzle with olive oil. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread or potatoes.

recipes.title: Spanish Chorizo and Chickpea Short Ribs Stew
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the smoked paprika.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the chorizo, tomatoes, chickpeas and 300 ml water, with the spinach at the end, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Drizzle with olive oil. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread or potatoes.

recipes.title: Spanish Sherry and Olive Braised Beef

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the paprika.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the sherry, bay leaves, pepper and 300 ml stock or water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Stir in the olives. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread or potatoes.

recipes.title: Spanish Sherry and Olive Braised Short Ribs
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the paprika.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the sherry, bay leaves, pepper and 300 ml stock or water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Stir in the olives. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread or potatoes.

recipes.title: Spanish Saffron and Almond Beef Pepitoria-Style

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the saffron.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the wine and stock; at the end blend the almonds and egg yolks with some sauce and stir back in, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Chop the egg whites over the top. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread or potatoes.

recipes.title: Spanish Saffron and Almond Short Ribs Pepitoria-Style
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the saffron.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the wine and stock; at the end blend the almonds and egg yolks with some sauce and stir back in, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Chop the egg whites over the top. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread or potatoes.

recipes.title: Spanish Pimentón Flank Steak Traybake
steps: Mix the smoked paprika, lemon juice, garlic and oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Spread on a tray with the potatoes, pepper and onion (start the potatoes 15 minutes earlier).
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Scatter with parsley.
Serve with crusty bread or potatoes.

recipes.title: Spanish Al Ajillo Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the sliced garlic and chili gently until golden, then the wine.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Scatter with parsley and serve with bread.
Serve with crusty bread or potatoes.

recipes.title: Spanish Albondigas en Salsa Beef Meatballs
steps: Mix the beef with the egg, breadcrumbs, paprika and half the garlic and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 16 balls.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 6 minutes, turning; they finish cooking in the sauce.
Cook the onion and garlic gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Add the wine and tomatoes and simmer the meatballs 20 minutes, until the meat is no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Scatter with parsley.
Serve with crusty bread or potatoes.

recipes.title: Roast Portuguese Piri-Piri Flank Steak
steps: Mix the chilies, paprika, lemon, vinegar, oregano and garlic blended with oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with fries or rice.

recipes.title: Portuguese Alentejana-Style Braised Beef

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the paprika.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the wine and bay leaves; add the clams for the last 5 minutes until they open, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Scatter with coriander. Taste for salt.
Serve with potatoes or rice.

recipes.title: Portuguese Alentejana-Style Braised Short Ribs
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the paprika.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the wine and bay leaves; add the clams for the last 5 minutes until they open, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Scatter with coriander. Taste for salt.
Serve with potatoes or rice.

recipes.title: Portuguese Garlic Wine Sirloin Steak Bitoque-Style
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the garlic and bay leaves, then the wine; bubble 2 minutes.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Serve each portion topped with a fried egg.

recipes.title: Greek Stifado Beef Stew

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the cinnamon and cloves.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the wine, vinegar, tomatoes, bay leaves and whole shallots, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Serve with rice or orzo. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Greek Stifado Short Ribs Stew
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the cinnamon and cloves.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the wine, vinegar, tomatoes, bay leaves and whole shallots, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Serve with rice or orzo. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Greek Lemon Oregano Beef Lemonato

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the oregano.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the lemon juice, stock and potatoes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Simmer uncovered until the sauce is reduced and lemony. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice, potatoes or warm pitta.

recipes.title: Greek Lemon Oregano Short Ribs Lemonato
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the oregano.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the lemon juice, stock and potatoes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Simmer uncovered until the sauce is reduced and lemony. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice, potatoes or warm pitta.

recipes.title: Greek Souvlaki Flank Steak Skewers
steps: Mix the lemon juice, oregano, garlic and oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Thread on skewers and cook on the grill; mix the yogurt and squeezed cucumber as tzatziki.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve in warm pitta with the tzatziki.

recipes.title: Greek Feta and Tomato Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and the oregano.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the cherry tomatoes until they burst, then the olives.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Crumble over the feta.
Serve with rice, potatoes or warm pitta.

recipes.title: Greek Keftedes Beef Meatballs
steps: Mix the beef with the egg, breadcrumbs, mint, oregano, onion and garlic and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 16 balls.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 8 minutes, turning, until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir together the yogurt seasoned with salt and a little garlic as a dip.
Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Turkish Pepper Paste Beef Güveç-Style

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces
Tomato paste (or Turkish red pepper paste)

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the pepper paste and Aleppo pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the tomatoes, eggplant, peppers and 300 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Serve with yogurt. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Turkish Pepper Paste Short Ribs Güveç-Style

ingredients.name: Tomato paste (or Turkish red pepper paste)

steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the pepper paste and Aleppo pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the tomatoes, eggplant, peppers and 300 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Serve with yogurt. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Turkish Şiş Flank Steak Skewers

ingredients.name: Tomato paste (or Turkish red pepper paste)

steps: Mix the yogurt, pepper paste, cumin and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Thread on skewers and cook on the grill.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with the onion tossed with sumac.

recipes.title: Turkish Köfte Beef Patties
steps: Mix the beef with the egg, breadcrumbs, cumin, pepper, parsley, onion and garlic and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 8 patties or logs.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 8 minutes, turning, until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir together the yogurt with a pinch of salt for serving.
Serve with flatbread, salad and the yogurt.

recipes.title: Moroccan Apricot Beef Tagine

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the ras el hanout and cinnamon.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion, garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the apricots, chickpeas, honey and 500 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Scatter with almonds. Taste for salt.
Serve with couscous.

recipes.title: Moroccan Apricot Short Ribs Tagine
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the ras el hanout and cinnamon.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion, garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the apricots, chickpeas, honey and 500 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Scatter with almonds. Taste for salt.
Serve with couscous.

recipes.title: Moroccan Preserved Lemon and Olive Beef Tagine

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces
Preserved lemons, chopped (or 1 lemon, zested and juiced)

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the turmeric and ginger.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion, garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the preserved lemon and 400 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Stir in the olives and coriander. Taste for salt.
Serve with couscous.

recipes.title: Moroccan Preserved Lemon and Olive Short Ribs Tagine

ingredients.name: Preserved lemons, chopped (or 1 lemon, zested and juiced)

steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the turmeric and ginger.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion, garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the preserved lemon and 400 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Stir in the olives and coriander. Taste for salt.
Serve with couscous.

recipes.title: Roast Moroccan Chermoula Flank Steak
steps: Mix the herbs, cumin, paprika, lemon and garlic blended with oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on a lined tray.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Moroccan Kefta Beef Tagine
steps: Mix the beef with the cumin, paprika, parsley and half the onion and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 8 patties or logs.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 6 minutes, turning; they finish cooking in the sauce.
Cook the onion, garlic and ginger gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes; simmer the meatballs 15 minutes, then crack in the eggs, cover and cook 6 minutes, until the meat is no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Serve with bread.

recipes.title: American Pot Roast-Style Braised Beef

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the thyme and tomato paste.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the stock, with the carrots and potatoes for the last hour, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Thicken the gravy if you like and serve. Taste for salt.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American Pot Roast-Style Braised Short Ribs
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the thyme and tomato paste.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the stock, with the carrots and potatoes for the last hour, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Thicken the gravy if you like and serve. Taste for salt.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American BBQ Flank Steak Traybake
steps: Mix the paprika, sugar, garlic powder and half the sauce with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill, brushing with the rest of the sauce for the last 10 minutes.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with coleslaw.

recipes.title: Roast American Maple Mustard Flank Steak
steps: Mix the maple, mustard, vinegar and rosemary with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on a lined tray.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Spoon over the pan juices.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American Honey Garlic Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the garlic for 30 seconds, then the honey, soy sauce and vinegar; bubble until sticky.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Turn to coat.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American Creamy Tuscan-Style Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and the Italian seasoning.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the sun-dried tomatoes and garlic, then the cream and parmesan, then the spinach until wilted.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon over.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American Sloppy Joe-Style Beef Sandwiches
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the beef and the pepper and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, sugar and 100 ml water and simmer 10 minutes.
Pile onto toasted buns.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: British Ale Beef Stew

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the flour and thyme.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the ale, Worcestershire sauce, bay leaves, carrots and 200 ml stock, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Serve with mash or crusty bread. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: British Ale Short Ribs Stew
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the flour and thyme.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the ale, Worcestershire sauce, bay leaves, carrots and 200 ml stock, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Serve with mash or crusty bread. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: British Honey Mustard Flank Steak Traybake
steps: Mix the mustard, honey, thyme and oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Spread on a tray with the potatoes and parsnips (start the vegetables 15 minutes earlier).
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Spoon over the sticky juices.
Serve with mashed potatoes and greens.

recipes.title: British Peppercorn Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and the crushed peppercorns.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the cream and mustard; bubble 2 minutes.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon over and serve with chips or salad.
Serve with mashed potatoes and greens.

recipes.title: Thai Holy Basil Pork Tenderloin Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: Basil leaves (Thai holy basil if you can find it)

steps: Slice the pork tenderloin into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar and 3 tbsp water.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the pork tenderloin in two batches, about 3 minutes per batch, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the onion with the garlic and chilies for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the pork tenderloin with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Turn off the heat and stir in the basil until it wilts.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Cashew Pork Tenderloin Stir-Fry
steps: Slice the pork tenderloin into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar and 3 tbsp water.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the pork tenderloin in two batches, about 3 minutes per batch, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the pepper and the white parts of the spring onions with the garlic and chilies for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the pork tenderloin with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss in the cashews and green spring onion.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Ginger Pork Tenderloin Stir-Fry
steps: Slice the pork tenderloin into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce and 3 tbsp water.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the pork tenderloin in two batches, about 3 minutes per batch, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the ginger, onion and mushrooms with the garlic and chilies for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the pork tenderloin with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Scatter with coriander if you have it.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Massaman Pork Shoulder Curry

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, boneless, cut into 5 cm pieces

steps: Pat the pork shoulder dry and season well with salt and the curry paste.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork shoulder in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coconut milk, potatoes, onion and 300 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is tender enough to pull apart.
Stir in the fish sauce, sugar and lime juice and scatter with peanuts. Taste for salt.
Serve with jasmine rice.

Add the coconut milk, potatoes, onion and 300 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 1½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is soft and glossy.

Serve with jasmine rice.

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, boneless, cut into 5 cm pieces

Add the coconut milk and 200 ml water, adding the pepper and beans for the last 10 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is tender enough to pull apart.
Season with the fish sauce and sugar and stir in the basil. Taste for salt.
Serve with jasmine rice.

Season with the fish sauce and sugar and stir in the basil. Taste for salt.
Serve with jasmine rice.

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, boneless, cut into 5 cm pieces
